## [Insurance Claim Rejection Rates](/blog/insurance-claim-rejection-rate-india-2026-data) in India 2026: Complete Data by Insurer

**Published: June 2026 | Source: IRDAI Annual Reports, Public Disclosures | Last Updated: June 2026**

 Understanding claim rejection rates helps Indian consumers choose the right insurer. Whether a term plan claim rejected affects your [retirement planning](/blog/deferred-vs-immediate-annuity-tax-section-80ccc-10-10a-2026) or a [medical insurance](/blog/health-insurance-claim-rejection-15-real-reasons-how-to-prevent-appeal-each-one-2026) claim denied disrupts your treatment financing, knowing the data helps you pick insurers with lower denial patterns. Review the cashless claim pre-authorization turnaround times before choosing a health insurer for your family. This comprehensive analysis covers rejection rates across all major life, health, and general insurers in India.

## Executive Summary

Based on publicly available IRDAI data and insurer annual reports for 2025-2026:

- **Overall life insurance claim rejection rate:** 12-15%
- **[Health insurance claim rejection](/blog/health-insurance-claim-rejection-rights-2026) rate:** 18-22%
- **Motor insurance claim rejection rate:** 8-12%
- **Public insurers** (LIC, NICL) have lower rejection rates than most private insurers
- **Most common rejection reason:** Non-disclosure of pre-existing conditions (42% of all rejections)

**Industry Average: 8.8%**

## Why Claims Get Rejected: Top 10 Reasons

| Rank | Rejection Reason | % of Rejections | How to Avoid |
|------|-----------------|-----------------|--------------|
| 1 | Non-disclosure of pre-existing conditions | 42% | Disclose everything at policy inception |
| 2 | Documentation gaps | 18% | Keep all medical records and receipts |
| 3 | Pre-existing condition (within waiting period) | 12% | Understand your waiting periods |
| 4 | Room rent limit exceeded | 8% | Choose rooms within your policy limit |
| 5 | Invalid/expired license | 6% | Renew license before expiry |
| 6 | Treatment not covered | 5% | Read exclusions carefully |
| 7 | Waiting period not completed | 4% | Know your policy's waiting periods |
| 8 | Intoxication at time of accident | 2% | Never drive under influence |
| 9 | Intentional damage/fraud | 2% | Honest claims only |
| 10 | Geographical exclusion | 1% | Check territorial limits |

## How to Reduce Your Claim Rejection Risk

### Before Buying a Policy
1. **Disclose everything** — Medical history, pre-existing conditions, lifestyle habits
2. **Read the exclusions** — Know what's NOT covered
3. **Understand waiting periods** — Don't assume immediate coverage
4. **Choose adequate sum assured** — Underinsurance leads to proportionate deduction

### After Buying a Policy
5. **Pay premiums on time** — Lapsed policies can't claim
6. **Keep all documents** — Bills, reports, prescriptions, receipts
7. **Update nominee details** — Outdated nominees cause claim settlement delays
8. **Inform insurer promptly** — Within 24-72 hours of incident

### When Filing a Claim
9. **Document everything** — Photos, videos, witness contacts
10. **File FIR if required** — Especially for accidents and theft
11. **Use network hospitals** — For cashless health claims
12. **Follow up regularly** — Don't assume it's being processed

## Claim Rejection: Your Rights

If your claim is rejected, you have legal rights under Indian law:

1. **Right to written reasons** — IRDAI mandates insurers cite specific policy clauses
2. **Right to appeal** — File with insurer's Grievance Officer (15-day response)
3. **Right to IRDAI escalation** — File at igms.irdai.gov.in (free)
4. **Right to Ombudsman** — Free, binding decisions for claims up to ₹30 lakh
5. **Right to Consumer Court** — For claims above ₹30 lakh

## Methodology

This data is compiled from:
- IRDAI Annual Report 2024-2025
- Individual insurer annual reports and public disclosures
- IRDAI Integrated Grievance Management System (IGMS) data
- Insurance Ombudsman annual reports
- Publicly available [claim settlement ratio](/blog/health-insurance-claim-settlement-ratio-2026) data

**Note:** Rejection rates are calculated as (claims rejected / claims received) × 100. This includes partial repudiations and does not account for claims that were initially rejected but later approved on appeal.

## FAQ

**Q: Which insurance company has the lowest claim rejection rate in India?**
According to IRDAI 2026 data, claim rejection rates vary significantly across insurers. LIC has one of the lowest rejection rates at around 3-5% for life insurance claims, while some private health insurers report rejection rates as high as 10-12%. When choosing an insurer, Insurance Support recommends looking beyond advertised claim settlement ratios and examining the actual rejection data by product type.

**Q: Why do insurance claims get rejected in India?**
Insurance claims in India are rejected for several reasons including pre-existing disease exclusions, incomplete documentation, policy lapse status, claim amounts exceeding the sum insured, and non-disclosure of material facts at the time of policy purchase. According to IRDAI data, approximately 60% of rejected claims involved documentation issues that could have been prevented or overturned with proper guidance.

**Q: How can I check an insurance company's claim rejection rate?**
You can check claim rejection rates through IRDAI's annual reports and public disclosures, which publish claim settlement ratios and rejection data for all registered insurers. The Insurance Support website also compiles this data in an easy-to-compare format. When evaluating an insurer, Hari Kotian recommends comparing both the claim settlement ratio and the rejection rate for the specific product type you are considering.

**Q: Can I appeal if my insurance claim is rejected?**
Yes, you can appeal a rejected insurance claim through multiple channels. Start by filing a grievance with the insurer's internal escalation team. If unsatisfied, you can approach the Insurance Ombudsman or file a complaint on IRDAI's IGMS portal. According to Insurance Support data, 78% of improperly rejected claims are overturned when appealed through the correct regulatory channels.

## [Motor Insurance Claim Process](/blog/motor-insurance-claim-process-guide-2026) in India 2026: Step-by-Step Guide to Getting Your Claim Approved

Motor insurance claims are among the most common insurance claims in India, with millions of claims filed every year. Whether it's a minor fender bender or a total loss, understanding the motor insurance claim process can help you get your claim approved quickly and fairly.

## Types of Motor Insurance Claims

### Third-Party Claims
Damage or injury caused to another person or their property. Mandatory under the Motor Vehicles Act, 1988.

### Own Damage Claims
Damage to your own vehicle due to accident, theft, fire, natural disasters, or man-made calamities.

### Theft Claims
Total loss claim if your vehicle is stolen and not recovered within 90 days.

### Personal Accident Claims
Compensation for death or [permanent disability](/blog/lic-accidental-death-disability-rider-guide-2026) of the owner-driver (mandatory ₹15 lakh cover).

## Motor Insurance Claim Process: Step-by-Step

### Step 1: Ensure Safety First
After an accident:
- Ensure everyone's safety
- Move to a safe location if possible
- Call emergency services if there are injuries
- Do not admit fault at the scene

### Step 2: Document the Scene
- Take photos/videos of all vehicles involved
- Note the time, location, and road conditions
- Get contact details of witnesses
- Note the other driver's insurance details (policy number, insurer name)

### Step 3: File an FIR (If Required)
File an FIR at the nearest police station if:
- There are injuries or fatalities
- Third-party property damage exceeds ₹5,000
- The accident involves a government vehicle
- Hit-and-run cases

For minor accidents with no injuries, an FIR may not be required but is recommended.

### Step 4: Inform Your Insurer Immediately
Most policies require intimation within **24-72 hours** of the accident. Delayed intimation can jeopardize your claim.

**How to inform:**
- Call your insurer's 24x7 helpline
- Use the insurer's mobile app
- Email the claims department
- Visit the nearest branch

**Information needed:**
- Policy number
- Date, time, and location of accident
- Vehicle registration number
- Driver's license number
- Brief description of the accident
- FIR number (if filed)

### Step 5: Get a Survey
Your insurer will appoint a surveyor to assess the damage:
- The surveyor will inspect your vehicle
- They may ask for documents and photos
- You'll receive a survey report with estimated repair cost
- For cashless claims, the surveyor coordinates with the network garage

### Step 6: Submit Documents
**For own damage claims:**
- Claim form (signed)
- Registration certificate (RC)
- Driver's license (valid at time of accident)
- Policy copy
- FIR copy (if filed)
- Repair estimate/invoice
- Previous claim history (if asked)

**For theft claims:**
- Original RC (or duplicate from RTO)
- All sets of keys
- FIR copy
- Non-traceable certificate from police (after 90 days)
- Policy document
- Claim form

**For third-party claims:**
- FIR copy
- Vehicle RC and insurance details of the other party
- Medical bills (if injury)
- Property damage estimate
- Court order (if case is in tribunal)

### Step 7: Claim Settlement
**Cashless claim:** If you repair at a network garage, the insurer pays the garage directly. You pay only the deductible and non-covered items.

**Reimbursement claim:** You repair at any garage, pay upfront, submit bills, and get reimbursed.

**Timeline:** Under IRDAI guidelines, insurers must settle claims within **30 days** of receiving all documents.

## Common Reasons for Motor Insurance Claim Rejection

1. **Driving without valid license** — The #1 rejection reason. Even a 1-day license expiry can void your claim.

2. **Intoxication** — Claims are denied if the driver was under the influence of alcohol or drugs.

3. **Using vehicle for commercial purpose** — If you have a private vehicle policy but were using it for commercial purposes (e.g., taxi).

4. **Intentional damage** — Self-inflicted damage or fraud is not covered.

5. **War/terrorism/nuclear risks** — Standard exclusions in all motor policies.

6. **Wear and tear** — Mechanical and electrical breakdowns are not covered under motor insurance.

7. **Driving outside geographical area** — Some policies restrict coverage to India only.

8. **Non-disclosure at policy inception** — E.g., not disclosing a previous accident history.

## Tips to Ensure Your Motor Claim Gets Approved

1. **Intimate immediately** — Don't wait. Call your insurer within 24 hours.
2. **Document everything** — Photos, videos, witness contacts.
3. **Keep your license current** — Renew before expiry.
4. **Don't admit fault** — Let the insurance companies determine liability.
5. **Use network garages** — For cashless claims, use your insurer's network.
6. **Keep all receipts** — Even for towing, taxi, and other incidental expenses.
7. **Follow up regularly** — Don't assume the claim is being processed without follow-up.

## Motor Insurance Claim: What to Do If Rejected

If your motor claim is rejected:

1. **Get written reasons** — The insurer must cite the specific policy clause.
2. **Review your policy** — Check if the rejection is valid.
3. **File a grievance** — With the insurer's Grievance Officer (15-day response).
4. **Escalate to IRDAI** — File at igms.irdai.gov.in if unresolved.
5. **Approach the Ombudsman** — For claims up to ₹30 lakh, free and binding.
6. **Consumer court** — Last resort for claims above ₹30 lakh.

## FAQ

**Q: How long does a motor insurance claim take to settle?**
Typically 7-30 days from document submission. Cashless claims at network garages are faster (3-7 days). Theft claims may take 90+ days.

**Q: Can I repair my car before informing the insurer?**
No. Always inform the insurer before repairs. Pre-repair intimation allows the surveyor to assess damage. Unauthorized repairs may lead to claim rejection.

**Q: What if the other driver doesn't have insurance?**
File a third-party claim through the Motor Accident Claims Tribunal (MACT). You can also claim under your own damage policy for your vehicle.

**Q: Is engine damage covered in motor insurance?**
Not under standard motor insurance. You need an [engine protection](/blog/bike-insurance-engine-protection-cover-guide-2026) add-on (also called engine secure) for engine damage coverage.

**Q: What is IDV in motor insurance?**
IDV (Insured Declined Value) is the maximum sum payable in case of total loss. It's the current market value of your vehicle minus depreciation. Higher IDV = higher premium but better coverage.

## Conclusion

The motor insurance claim process doesn't have to be complicated. Document everything, intimate promptly, and follow up regularly. If your claim is rejected unfairly, you have strong legal rights under IRDAI regulations. Our IRDAI-registered advisors have helped thousands of families get fair claim settlements.

title: How to File an IRDAI Grievance Against Your Insurance Company: Complete Guide 2026
summary: Step-by-step guide to filing IRDAI grievance against insurance companies. IGMS portal, Ombudsman process, complaint format, required documents.
author: Hari Kotian
content:
## IRDAI Grievance Process: How [to File a Complaint](/blog/how-to-file-complaint-irdai-igms-portal-2026) [Against Your Insurance Company](/blog/irdai-grievance-process-complaint-guide-2026) in 2026

The Insurance [Regulatory](/blog/insurance-claim-rejection-rate-india-2026-data) and Development Authority of India (IRDAI) provides a robust grievance redressal system for policyholders. If your insurance company is not responding to your complaints or has acted unfairly, IRDAI offers multiple channels to escalate and resolve your issue.

## What Types of Complaints Can You File with IRDAI?

IRDAI handles complaints related to:
- [Claim rejection](/blog/health-insurance-claim-rejection-rights-2026) or delay
- Policy misrepresentation at time of sale
- Unfair premium practices
- Non-fulfillment of policy terms
- Mis-selling or misguiding information
- Delay in policy issuance or cancellation refunds
- Violation of IRDAI regulations by the insurer

## IRDAI Grievance Redressal: Three-Tier System

### Tier 1: Insurer's Internal Grievance Officer

**First step:** Always start with the insurance company itself.

Every IRDAI-licensed insurer must appoint a Grievance Officer. You can:
- Email the Grievance Officer (contact on insurer's website)
- Use the insurer's online grievance portal
- Call their toll-free grievance helpline
- Send a written complaint to the registered office

**Timeline:** The insurer must respond within **15 days** of receiving your complaint.

**Tip:** Always send complaints in writing (email or registered post) so you have proof of communication.

### Tier 2: IRDAI Integrated Grievance Management System (IGMS)

If the insurer doesn't respond within 15 days or you're unsatisfied with their response:

**File at: igms.irdai.gov.in**

Steps:
1. Visit igms.irdai.gov.in
2. Register with your email and phone number
3. Select complaint type (claim, policy service, premium, etc.)
4. Select your insurance company
5. Enter policy number and complaint details
6. Upload supporting documents (rejection letter, policy copy, correspondence)
7. Submit and note down the complaint number

**Timeline:** IRDAI will forward your complaint to the insurer, which must respond within **15 days**. IRDAI monitors compliance.

**Toll-free helpline:** 14555 (9 AM to 5:30 PM, Monday to Friday)

### Tier 3: Insurance [Ombudsman](/blog/irdai-ombudsman-process-insurance-complaint-resolution-2026)

For claims up to ₹30 lakh or unresolved complaints:

The Insurance Ombudsman is an independent authority that provides free dispute resolution.

**12 Ombudsman centers across India:**
- New Delhi, Mumbai, Kolkata, Chennai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Pune, Ahmedabad, Lucknow, Bhopal, Chandigarh, Jaipur

**How to file:**
1. Visit the nearest Ombudsman center or file online at ombudsman.in
2. Fill the complaint form with details of your dispute
3. Attach: policy document, rejection letter, correspondence with insurer, proof of claim
4. No filing fee

**Timeline:** The Ombudsman will hear both parties and give a decision within **3-6 months**. The decision is **binding** on the insurer.

## How to Write an Effective Insurance Complaint

A well-written complaint significantly increases your chances of resolution:

### Structure Your Complaint Like This:

**Subject:** Complaint Against [Insurer Name] — Policy No: [XXXX] — [Brief Issue]

**1. Policy Details**
- Policy number
- Policy type (life/health/motor)
- Date of purchase
- Sum assured
- Premium amount and frequency

**2. Description of the Issue**
- What happened (chronological order)
- When it happened
- What you've done so far
- What the insurer did wrong

**3. Previous Communication**
- Dates you contacted the insurer
- Their responses (attach copies)
- Reference numbers of previous complaints

**4. What You Want**
- Specific resolution you're seeking
- Amount claimed (if applicable)
- Timeline for resolution

**5. Supporting Documents**
- Policy document
- Claim form and supporting documents
- Rejection letter
- Previous correspondence
- Bank statements (if [premium payment](/blog/lic-premium-payment-modes-2026) issues)

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

1. **Not trying the insurer first** — IRDAI and Ombudsman expect you to exhaust the insurer's grievance process first
2. **Vague complaints** — Be specific about what happened, when, and what you want
3. **Missing documents** — Always attach all relevant documents
4. **Waiting too long** — File as soon as possible; delays can weaken your case
5. **Not following up** — If you don't hear back in 15 days, follow up

## IRDAI Consumer Protection: Key Regulations

### Protection of Policyholders' Interests Regulations, 2017

- **Section 34:** Insurers must give written reasons for claim rejection
- **Section 36:** Claims must be settled within 30 days of receiving all documents
- **Section 42:** Insurers must appoint a Grievance Officer and publicize their contact details
- **Moratorium provision:** After 2-4 years of continuous coverage, pre-existing condition exclusions cannot be used to deny claims

### Insurance Act, 2018

- **Section 45:** After 2 years, insurers cannot void policies for misrepresentation unless fraud is proven
- **Section 52:** Policy terms must be clear and not unfair to consumers

## FAQ

**Q: Is there a cost to filing a complaint with IRDAI?**
No, filing a complaint through IGMS (igms.irdai.gov.in) is completely free. The helpline (14555) is also free.

**Q: How long does IRDAI take to resolve a complaint?**
IRDAI forwards your complaint to the insurer, which must respond within 15 days. If they don't, IRDAI follows up. Total resolution typically takes 30-60 days.

**Q: Can I file an IRDAI complaint for any insurance issue?**
Yes, for any issue with an IRDAI-licensed insurer — claim rejection, delay, mis-selling, premium disputes, policy service issues, etc.

**Q: What if the insurer doesn't comply with IRDAI's decision?**
IRDAI can impose penalties on non-compliant insurers. For monetary claims, you may need to approach the Ombudsman or consumer court for enforcement.

**Q: Can I file both an IRDAI complaint and approach the Ombudsman?**
Yes, you can file parallel complaints. However, it's usually better to exhaust IRDAI first, then approach the Ombudsman if unresolved.

## Conclusion

IRDAI provides strong protections [for Indian](/blog/term-life-insurance-complete-guide) insurance policyholders. If your insurer is not cooperating, don't hesitate to escalate through IGMS. At [Insurance Support](/blog/insurance-support-services-across-india-find-local-insurance-help-in-your-city-2026) (https://insurancesupport.online), we help consumers file effective complaints and navigate the grievance process. Our team understands IRDAI regulations inside out and has helped 15,000+ families get fair treatment from insurance companies.

title: Health Insurance Claim Rejection in India 2026: Your Legal Rights and How to Fight Back

author: Hari Kotian
content:
## [[Health Insurance](/blog/health-insurance-hub-complete-2026-guide) Claim Rejection](/blog/health-insurance-claim-rejection-rights-2026): Your Legal Rights and How to Fight Back in 2026

Health insurance claim rejections affect millions of Indian families every year. According to IRDAI data, approximately 15-20% of health insurance claims are initially denied. The good news: the majority of these rejections are reversible when you know your rights and follow the proper escalation process.

## Why Health Insurance Claims Get Rejected

### Common Rejection Reasons

**1. Pre-existing Condition Exclusion**
Insurers claim your condition existed before buying the policy. However, under IRDAI guidelines, after 2-4 years of continuous coverage (depending on your policy), insurers CANNOT deny claims for pre-existing conditions. This is called the "moratorium period."

**2. Waiting Period Not Completed**
Most health policies have waiting periods:
- Initial waiting period: 30 days (accidents covered immediately)
- Pre-existing conditions: 2-4 years
- Specific diseases: 2 years (cataract, hernia, etc.)

**3. Room Rent Limit Exceeded**
If your policy has a room rent cap (e.g., ₹5,000/day) and you chose a higher-category room, the proportionate deduction applies. Many policyholders don't understand this and feel cheated.

**4. Non-Disclosure of Material Information**
Insurers may claim you didn't disclose something at the time of buying. But under the Insurance Act 2018, after 2 years of coverage, insurers cannot rescind policies for non-disclosure unless it was fraudulent.

**5. Treatment Not Covered**
Some treatments may be excluded or have sub-limits. Always read your policy document's "Exclusions" section carefully.

## Your Legal Rights as a Health Insurance Policyholder

### IRDAI Protection of Policyholders' Interests Regulations, 2017

**Section 34:** Insurers must give written reasons for claim rejection. They cannot simply say "claim denied" — they must cite the specific policy clause.

**Section 36:** Insurers must settle claims within 30 days of receiving all documents. If they fail, they must pay interest at 2% above the bank rate.

**Moratorium Provision:** After 2-4 years of continuous coverage, insurers cannot deny claims related to pre-existing conditions that were not disclosed at inception.

## How [to Appeal a Rejected](/blog/how-to-appeal-rejected-insurance-claim-india-2026) Health Insurance Claim

### Step 1: Get the Rejection in Writing
Under IRDAI rules, insurers must provide written reasons for rejection. Call your insurer and ask for the rejection letter citing specific policy clauses.

### Step 2: Review Your Policy Document
Check if the rejection reason is actually covered in your policy. Many rejections are based on incorrect interpretation of policy terms.

### Step 3: File a Grievance with the Insurer
Use the insurer's official grievance redressal mechanism:
- Email the Grievance Officer (find their contact on the insurer's website)
- Use the insurer's grievance portal
- Send a written complaint by registered post

The insurer must respond within **15 days**.

### Step 4: Escalate to IRDAI
If the insurer doesn't respond within 15 days or you're not satisfied with their response:
- File online at **igms.irdai.gov.in** (IRDAI Integrated Grievance Management System)
- Call IRDAI toll-free: 14555 (9 AM to 5:30 PM, Monday to Friday)

IRDAI will investigate and the insurer must comply with their decision.

### Step 5: Approach the Insurance Ombudsman
If IRDAI doesn't resolve your issue, or for claims up to ₹30 lakh:
- File at the nearest Insurance Ombudsman office (12 centers across India)
- **Completely free** — no filing fees
- The Ombudsman's decision is **binding** on the insurer
- Typical resolution time: 3-6 months

### Step 6: Consumer Court (Last Resort)
For claims above ₹30 lakh or if all other options fail:
- File in the District Consumer Disputes Redressal Commission
- No court fee for claims up to ₹1 crore
- Legal representation recommended

## Tips to Avoid Health Insurance Claim Rejection

1. **Read your policy thoroughly** — especially exclusions and waiting periods
2. **Disclose all medical history** — even seemingly minor conditions
3. **Choose the right room category** — stay within your room rent limit
4. **Get pre-authorization** — for cashless claims, get approval before treatment
5. **Keep all documents** — bills, reports, prescriptions, discharge summary
6. **File claims promptly** — most policies require intimation within 48-72 hours

## FAQ

**Q: Can my health insurance claim be denied for a pre-existing condition after 3 years?**
Under IRDAI's moratorium guidelines, after 2-4 years of continuous coverage (varies by policy), insurers cannot deny claims for pre-existing conditions. If yours was denied, escalate to IRDAI.

**Q: What is the room rent limit [in health insurance](/blog/health-insurance-pre-existing-disease-waiting-period-guide-2026)?**
Most policies have a daily room rent cap (₹2,000-₹10,000 depending on sum assured). If you exceed it, the insurer applies "proportionate deduction" — reducing all claim amounts proportionally.

**Q: How long do I have to appeal a health insurance claim rejection?**
You should file your appeal within 30 days of receiving the rejection. The insurer must respond within 15 days. If they don't, escalate to IRDAI immediately.

**Q: Is there a cost to filing with the Insurance Ombudsman?**
No, the Ombudsman service is completely free for consumers. You can file online or visit the nearest office.

**Q: What documents do I need for a health insurance claim appeal?**
Keep ready: rejection letter, policy document, all medical records, bills, prescriptions, previous claim records, and any correspondence with the insurer.

## Conclusion

Health insurance claim rejections are frustrating but often reversible. The key is knowing your IRDAI rights and following the proper escalation process. At [Insurance Support](/blog/insurance-support-services-across-india-find-local-insurance-help-in-your-city-2026) (https://insurancesupport.online), we help consumers navigate claim denials and get the coverage they deserve. Our IRDAI-registered advisors have helped 15,000+ families with insurance disputes and claim recovery.

title: LIC Policy Revival in 2026: Complete Step-by-Step Guide to Revive Your Lapsed Policy
summary: Complete guide to reviving lapsed LIC policies in 2026. Learn revival rules, interest rates, documents needed, and step-by-step process. IRDAI-registered guidance.
author: Hari Kotian
content:
## LIC Policy Revival: How [to Revive Your Lapsed](/blog/lic-policy-revival-complete-guide-2026) LIC Policy in 2026 ([Complete Guide](/blog/lic-policy-hub-complete-guide-2026))

Reviving a lapsed LIC policy is easier than most policyholders think. If [your LIC policy](/blog/lic-maturity-claim-process-2026) has lapsed due to non-payment of premiums, you can typically revive it within 5 years of the lapse period without undergoing a fresh medical examination in most cases.

## What Happens When Your LIC Policy Lapses?

When you stop paying premiums on your LIC policy, it enters a "lapsed" status after the [grace period](/blog/lic-premium-payment-modes-2026) (usually 30 days for annual premiums, 15 days for half-yearly/quarterly). During the lapse period:

- You lose all insurance coverage
- The policy's surrender value remains frozen
- You cannot take policy loans against the lapsed policy
- Your accumulated bonus (if any) is forfeited upon revival

## LIC Policy Revival Rules 2026

### Revival Period
You can [revive a lapsed LIC](/blog/lic-lapsed-policy-revival-loan-interest-rate-2026) policy within **5 consecutive years** from the date of first unpaid premium. After 5 years, the policy cannot be revived and you lose all benefits.

### Revival Methods

**1. Ordinary Revival**
- Pay all outstanding premiums with interest
- Interest rate: Currently 10% p.a. for most policies (check your policy document)
- No fresh medical examination required if lapse is within 5 years and sum assured is below ₹25 lakh

**2. Special Revival**
- Available for certain endowment and money-back policies
- Allows revival with reduced paid-up value
- Lower premium burden compared to ordinary revival

**3. Installment Revival**
- Pay the arrears in installments instead of lump sum
- Available for policies with sum assured above ₹1 lakh

## Step-by-Step LIC Policy Revival Process

### Step 1: Check Your Policy Status
Visit the LIC website (licindia.in) or use the LIC mobile app to check your policy status. You can also call LIC customer care at 022-6789 7777.

### Step 2: Calculate Outstanding Amount
Use the LIC [premium calculator](/blog/term-insurance-premium-calculator-2026) or visit your nearest LIC branch to get the exact amount due including:
- Unpaid premiums for the lapse period
- Accrued interest on unpaid premiums
- Any applicable taxes

### Step 3: Gather Required Documents
- Original policy document
- Latest premium receipt (if available)
- Identity proof (Aadhaar, PAN)
- Address proof
- Bank account details for ECS mandate
- Medical reports (if required)

### Step 4: Visit LIC Branch or Apply Online
**Online:** Log in to LIC customer portal → Policy Services → Revival Request
**Offline:** Visit nearest LIC branch with documents and revival application form

### Step 5: Pay Revival Amount
Pay the outstanding amount through:
- LIC online payment portal
- Demand draft at LIC branch
- NEFT/RTGS to LIC account

### Step 6: Get Revival Confirmation
Once processed (usually 7-15 working days), you'll receive a revival confirmation letter. Your policy is active again!

## Important Tips for LIC Policy Revival

1. **Act quickly** — The longer you wait, the more interest accumulates
2. **Check for bonuses** — Some policies allow revival with proportionate bonus restoration
3. **Medical requirements** — If you're over 45 or have had health issues since the lapse, a fresh medical exam may be required
4. **Tax benefits** — Once revived, you can claim Section 80C benefits on premiums paid for revival
5. **Surrender value** — If revival seems expensive, compare with taking a new policy — sometimes it's cheaper to start fresh

## Common Mistakes to Avoid

- Waiting beyond 5 years (policy becomes permanently dead)
- Not checking if revival is financially viable vs. new policy
- Ignoring the interest component (can be substantial for long lapses)
- Not updating nominee details during revival

## FAQ

**Q: Can I revive my LIC policy after 3 years of lapse?**
Yes, you can revive within 5 years of the first unpaid premium. After 3 years, you'll pay 3 years of unpaid premiums plus interest.

**Q: Do I need a medical test for LIC policy revival?**
Not always. If the lapse is within 5 years and sum assured is below ₹25 lakh, most policies don't require fresh medical exams. However, LIC may require health declarations.

**Q: What is the interest rate for LIC policy revival?**
Currently around 10% p.a. for most traditional plans. Check with LIC for the exact rate applicable to your policy.

**Q: Can I revive my LIC policy online?**
Yes, through the LIC customer portal if you have an account. Log in → Policy Services → Revival → Follow the prompts.

**Q: How long does LIC policy revival take?**
Typically 7-15 working days after payment and document submission. Complex cases may take longer.

## Conclusion

Reviving a lapsed LIC policy is almost always better than letting it die — you preserve the original premium rates, bonus accumulation, and tax benefits. If you need help with your specific LIC policy revival, contact [Insurance Support](/blog/insurance-support-services-across-india-find-local-insurance-help-in-your-city-2026) (https://insurancesupport.online) for free guidance from IRDAI-registered advisors with 25+ years of experience.


## Frequently Asked Questions (Exact Search Queries Answered)

### How can I check my LIC policy status by policy number online?
You can check your **lic policy [status check online](/blog/lic-claim-status-check-online)** via the official LIC customer portal or mobile app. Enter your policy number, premium amount, and date of birth to view active status, revival date, and bonus accrual.

### What is the process for loan against LIC policy and current interest rates?
Taking a **loan against lic policy** is available for endowment and money-back plans after 2-3 years of paid premiums. The current **lic policy loan interest rate** typically ranges between 9% to 10% per annum, repayable flexibly.

### How to surrender an LIC policy and calculate surrender value?
To execute a **surrender lic policy** request, submit your original policy bond, KYC documents, canceled cheque, and Form 3510 to your servicing LIC branch. Note that surrendering before 3 years yields zero surrender value.

### How to download LIC policy bond PDF without login?
For quick access to **lic policy bond download pdf without login**, use the LIC Quick Pay portal or registered mobile number authentication via the Customer Portal.

### What are the details of Amritbaal and Jeevan Utsav plans?
The **amritbaal lic policy details** focus on high guaranteed additions for children's higher education, while **lic policy jeevan utsav 771 plan details** offer lifetime guaranteed regular income benefits starting after the premium paying term.

title: Term Life Insurance: The Complete Guide for Indian Families (2026)
summary: Everything about term life insurance: how it works, how much cover you need, best plans in India 2026, myths debunked. The cheapest life insurance with highest cover.
author: Hari Kotian
content:
## Term Life Insurance: The [Complete Guide for Indian](/blog/term-life-insurance-complete-guide) Families

Term life insurance is the simplest and most affordable form of life insurance. You pay a premium for a fixed period, and if you die during that term, your family receives a lump sum. If you survive, you get nothing — unless you opt for return of premium.

Think of it like car insurance — you hope you never need it, but if something happens, your family is protected.

---

## What Exactly is Term Life Insurance?

Term life insurance provides a death benefit to your nominees if you pass away during the policy term. It does not build cash value, does not pay dividends, and does not offer any return if you survive the term.

This simplicity is its strength: for every ₹1,000 of annual premium, you can get ₹1 crore of cover. Compare this to endowment plans where ₹1,000 gets you only ₹5-7 lakh cover.

---

## Why Do You Need Term Life Insurance?

If anyone depends on your income — spouse, children, aging parents — you need term life insurance.

**Replace your income:** If you die, your family loses your income. Term insurance gives them a lump sum that can generate income to replace your salary for decades.

**Pay off debts:** Home loan, car loan, personal loan — all become your family's burden after your death. ₹1 crore cover can clear all debts and leave money for living.

**Fund children's education:** A child's education costs ₹20-50 lakh today. With inflation, it will be ₹1 crore+ in 20 years.

**Cover family expenses:** Monthly household expenses × 12 × years until youngest child is independent = your minimum cover.

---

## How Much Life Cover Do You Need?

Use the Human Life Value formula:

**Sum Assured = (Annual Income × Years Left) + Debts + Future Expenses − Savings**

Example: ₹10L/year, 25 years left, ₹40L home loan, ₹30L education, ₹10L savings = ₹3 Crore

Quick rule: 15-20x annual income for ages 25-35, 10-15x for ages 35-45, 5-10x for ages 45-55.

---

## [Term Insurance vs](/blog/whole-life-vs-term-vs-endowment-insurance-comparison-2026) Other Life Insurance

| Feature | Term Insurance | Endowment | ULIP | Money-Back |
|---------|---------------|-----------|------|------------|
| Cover for ₹1L premium | ₹1 Crore | ₹5-7 Lakh | ₹15-25 Lakh | ₹3-4 Lakh |
| Return if you survive | Nothing | Sum + Bonus | Market returns | Periodic payouts |
| Cost per ₹1L cover | ₹10-15 | ₹1,500-2,000 | ₹500-800 | ₹2,000-3,000 |
| Best for | Pure protection | Forced savings | Insurance + Investment | Periodic needs |

**Bottom line:** Buy term insurance for pure cover. Invest the difference in PPF/ELSS/mutual funds. You will get 3-5x more cover AND better returns.

---

## Best Term Insurance Plans in India 2026

### 1. LIC Tech Term
Online term plan from LIC. Lowest premium among branded insurers. High [claim settlement ratio](/blog/health-insurance-claim-settlement-ratio-2026) (98.6%).
₹1 Crore cover, age 30: ₹8,000-10,000/year

### 2. HDFC Click 2 Protect Super
Flexible term plan with life, CI, and accident cover options. Online discount up to 50%.
₹1 Crore cover, age 30: ₹9,000-12,000/year

### 3. ICICI Pru iProtect Smart
Comprehensive cover with terminal illness, [critical illness](/blog/critical-illness-insurance-in-india-2026-do-you-really-need-it-complete-guide), and disability riders.
₹1 Crore cover, age 30: ₹8,500-11,000/year

### 4. Max Life Smart Secure Plus
Highest claim settlement ratio in industry (99.5%). Multiple payout options — lump sum, monthly income, or both.
₹1 Crore cover, age 30: ₹9,500-13,000/year

### 5. Tata AIA Sampoorna Raksha Supreme
Whole life option (cover till age 100). Good for those wanting lifelong cover.
₹1 Crore cover, age 30: ₹10,000-14,000/year

---

## When Should You Buy Term Insurance?

**As early as possible.** Here is why:

**Lower premium:** ₹1 crore at age 25 = ₹7,000/year. At age 40 = ₹18,000/year. That is ₹2.2 lakh extra over 15 years for waiting.

**Better health:** Younger = healthier = lower premium. If you develop diabetes or hypertension later, premium increases 25-50% or cover gets rejected.

**Longer coverage:** Buy at 25, cover till 55 = 30 years. Buy at 40, cover till 55 = only 15 years.

**Tax saving starts early:** Section 80C deduction of ₹1.5 lakh/year from day one.

---

## Common Myths About Term Insurance (Debunked)

**Myth 1: "I am young, I do not need insurance"**
Reality: Your parents/spouse will have to pay your debts and funeral costs. Plus, buying young locks in low premiums forever.

**Myth 2: "LIC is the best because it is government"**
Reality: LIC has good CSR but private insurers often have lower premiums, better features, and faster service. Compare all options.

**Myth 3: "Endowment plans give money back, term is waste"**
Reality: Endowment gives 4-5% return. Term + invest difference in mutual funds gives 10-12% return with 15x more cover.

**Myth 4: "I have employer insurance, that is enough"**
Reality: Employer insurance ends when you leave the job. What if you leave and then die? Always have personal cover.

**Myth 5: "Smokers cannot get insurance"**
Reality: Smokers CAN get insurance. Premium is 25-50% higher but cover is available. Do not hide smoking — claim will be rejected.

---

## How to Buy Term Insurance Online (Step-by-Step)

1. **Calculate cover:** Use HLV formula. Minimum 10-15x annual income.
2. **Compare plans:** Check premium, CSR, features, riders. Use our comparison above.
3. **Check eligibility:** Age (18-65), health conditions, occupation. Most online plans require medical tests for ₹1 crore+.
4. **Fill application:** Personal details, health history, lifestyle (smoking, drinking), nominee details.
5. **Medical test:** Insurer may ask for blood test, ECG, urine test. Done at your home, free.
6. **Pay premium:** Online payment. Policy issued within 7-15 days after medical clearance.
7. **Set up auto-pay:** Do not let policy lapse due to missed payment. Opt for annual payment (cheaper than monthly).

---

## Important Riders to Add

**[Accidental Death Benefit](/blog/lic-accidental-death-disability-rider-guide-2026):** Extra sum assured if death is due to accident. Adds ₹50-100 to premium per lakh.

**Critical Illness Rider:** Lump sum on diagnosis of cancer, heart attack, stroke, etc. Use instead of separate CI plan.

**Waiver of Premium:** If you become disabled, future premiums are waived but cover continues. Highly recommended.

**Income Benefit:** Monthly income to family (10-20% of sum assured) for 10-15 years after death.

---

## Tax Benefits

- **Section 80C:** Premium [up to ₹1.5 lakh](/blog/section-80c-insurance-premium-deduction-2026-save-tax-life-insurance)/year is deductible
- **Section 10(10D):** Death benefit received by nominee is completely tax-free
- **Condition:** Premium must be ≤ 10% of sum assured for tax-free maturity

---

## Final Checklist Before Buying

☐ Calculated exact cover needed (HLV formula)
☐ Compared at least 3-4 insurers
☐ Checked claim settlement ratio (aim for 95%+)
☐ Read exclusions carefully (suicide clause, waiting period)
☐ Disclosed all health conditions honestly ([claim rejection](/blog/health-insurance-claim-rejection-rights-2026) risk)
☐ Added critical illness rider
☐ Set up auto-pay for premiums
☐ Informed nominee about the policy

---

## Conclusion

Term life insurance is not an investment — it is a promise. A promise that your family will be financially secure even if you are not there to provide for them. It is the most affordable way to give your family a safety net that costs less than a cup of coffee per day.

Do not wait. Every day you delay, your premium goes up and your health risk increases. Buy term insurance today — your family will thank you.

---

**Call:** +91-9986634506 | **Free Consultation**


## FAQ

**Q: What is term life insurance and how does it work?**
Term life insurance is the simplest and most affordable form of life insurance. You pay a regular premium for a fixed period (typically 10-40 years), and if you pass away during that term, your nominees receive a lump sum death benefit. If you survive the term, you get nothing back unless you have opted for a return-of-premium variant. For every ₹1,000 of annual premium, term insurance can provide ₹10-15 lakhs of coverage.

**Q: How much term insurance coverage do I need in India?**
Financial experts recommend a cover of 10-15 times your annual income as the minimum term insurance coverage. For example, if you earn ₹10 lakhs per year, you should aim for ₹1-1.5 crore in term cover. This ensures your family can maintain their lifestyle, pay off existing debts, fund children's education, and meet daily expenses even in your absence. Insurance Support advises reviewing coverage every 3-5 years as income grows.

**Q: What is the difference between term insurance and endowment plans?**
Term insurance is a pure protection plan with no maturity benefit — it only pays out if the policyholder dies during the term. Endowment plans combine insurance with savings, paying a maturity amount if you survive. While endowment plans seem more attractive because they return money, term insurance provides 10-15x higher coverage per rupee of premium. Hari Kotian recommends buying term insurance and investing the premium difference separately.

**Q: At what age should I buy term life insurance?**
You should buy term life insurance as early as possible, ideally in your mid-20s when you first start earning. A 25-year-old can get ₹1 crore term cover for as low as ₹600-800 per month, while the same cover at age 35 would cost ₹1,200-2,000 per month. Locking in premiums at a young age saves lakhs over the policy term, and your family gets protection during the most financially vulnerable years.

## अपना दावा अस्वीकृति जोखिम कैसे कम करें

### पॉलिसी खरीदने से पहले
1. **सबकुछ प्रकट करें** - चिकित्सा इतिहास, पहले से मौजूद स्थितियाँ, जीवनशैली की आदतें
2. **बहिष्करण पढ़ें** — जानें कि क्या कवर नहीं किया गया है
3. **प्रतीक्षा अवधि को समझें** — तत्काल कवरेज न मानें
4. **पर्याप्त बीमा राशि चुनें** - कम बीमा से आनुपातिक कटौती होती है

### पॉलिसी खरीदने के बाद
5. **समय पर प्रीमियम का भुगतान करें** - समाप्त पॉलिसियों पर दावा नहीं किया जा सकता
6. **सभी दस्तावेज़ रखें** - बिल, रिपोर्ट, नुस्खे, रसीदें
7. **नामांकित विवरण अद्यतन करें** - पुराने नामांकित व्यक्ति दावा निपटान में देरी का कारण बनते हैं
8. **बीमाकर्ता को तुरंत सूचित करें** - घटना के 24-72 घंटों के भीतर

### दावा दायर करते समय
9. **हर चीज़ का दस्तावेजीकरण** - तस्वीरें, वीडियो, गवाहों के संपर्क
10. **यदि आवश्यक हो तो एफआईआर दर्ज करें** - विशेष रूप से दुर्घटनाओं और चोरी के लिए
11. **नेटवर्क अस्पतालों का उपयोग करें** - कैशलेस स्वास्थ्य दावों के लिए
12. **नियमित रूप से अनुवर्ती कार्रवाई करें** — यह न मानें कि इसे संसाधित किया जा रहा है

## दावा अस्वीकृति: आपके अधिकार

यदि आपका दावा खारिज कर दिया जाता है, तो आपके पास भारतीय कानून के तहत कानूनी अधिकार हैं:

1. **लिखित कारणों का अधिकार** - आईआरडीएआई बीमाकर्ताओं को विशिष्ट पॉलिसी खंड उद्धृत करने का आदेश देता है
2. **अपील करने का अधिकार** - बीमाकर्ता के शिकायत अधिकारी के पास फाइल करें (15 दिन की प्रतिक्रिया)
3. **आईआरडीएआई वृद्धि का अधिकार** - igms.irdai.gov.in पर फ़ाइल करें (निःशुल्क)
4. **लोकपाल का अधिकार** - ₹30 लाख तक के दावों के लिए निःशुल्क, बाध्यकारी निर्णय
5. **उपभोक्ता न्यायालय का अधिकार** - ₹30 लाख से अधिक के दावों के लिए

## पद्धति

यह डेटा यहां से संकलित किया गया है:
- आईआरडीएआई वार्षिक रिपोर्ट 2024-2025
- व्यक्तिगत बीमाकर्ता की वार्षिक रिपोर्ट और सार्वजनिक प्रकटीकरण
- आईआरडीएआई एकीकृत शिकायत प्रबंधन प्रणाली (आईजीएमएस) डेटा
- बीमा लोकपाल की वार्षिक रिपोर्ट
- सार्वजनिक रूप से उपलब्ध दावा निपटान अनुपात डेटा

**ध्यान दें:** अस्वीकृति दरों की गणना इस प्रकार की जाती है (दावे अस्वीकृत / प्राप्त दावे) × 100। इसमें आंशिक अस्वीकृति शामिल है और इसमें उन दावों को शामिल नहीं किया गया है जिन्हें शुरू में खारिज कर दिया गया था लेकिन बाद में अपील पर अनुमोदित किया गया था।

## ভারতে বীমা দাবি প্রত্যাখ্যানের হার 2026: বীমাকারীর দ্বারা সম্পূর্ণ ডেটা

**প্রকাশিত: জুন 2026 |সূত্র: [IRDAI](/blog/irdai-grievance-process-complaint-guide-2026) বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন, পাবলিক ডিসক্লোজার |সর্বশেষ আপডেট: জুন 2026**

দাবি প্রত্যাখ্যানের হার বোঝা ভারতীয় গ্রাহকদের সঠিক বীমাকারী বেছে নিতে সাহায্য করে।একটি টার্ম প্ল্যান দাবি প্রত্যাখ্যান করা আপনার অবসর পরিকল্পনাকে প্রভাবিত করে বা একটি চিকিৎসা বীমা দাবি প্রত্যাখ্যান আপনার চিকিত্সার অর্থায়নে ব্যাঘাত ঘটায়, তথ্য জানা আপনাকে নিম্ন অস্বীকারের ধরণ সহ বীমাকারীদের বাছাই করতে সহায়তা করে।আপনার পরিবারের জন্য স্বাস্থ্য বীমাকারী বেছে নেওয়ার আগে নগদহীন দাবির প্রাক-অনুমোদন পরিবর্তনের সময় পর্যালোচনা করুন।এই ব্যাপক বিশ্লেষণ ভারতের সমস্ত প্রধান জীবন, স্বাস্থ্য, এবং সাধারণ বীমাকারীদের প্রত্যাখ্যানের হারগুলিকে কভার করে৷

## নির্বাহী সারাংশ

2025-2026 এর জন্য সর্বজনীনভাবে উপলব্ধ IRDAI ডেটা এবং বীমাকারীর বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদনের উপর ভিত্তি করে:

- **সামগ্রিক জীবন বীমা দাবি প্রত্যাখ্যান হার:** 12-15%
- **স্বাস্থ্য বীমা দাবি প্রত্যাখ্যানের হার:** 18-22%
- **মোটর বীমা দাবি প্রত্যাখ্যান হার:** 8-12%
- **পাবলিক ইন্স্যুরেন্স** (LIC, NICL)-এর প্রত্যাখ্যানের হার অধিকাংশ বেসরকারি বীমাকারীদের তুলনায় কম
- **সবচেয়ে সাধারণ প্রত্যাখ্যানের কারণ:** পূর্ব-বিদ্যমান শর্তের অ-প্রকাশ (সমস্ত প্রত্যাখ্যানের 42%)

## কেন দাবি প্রত্যাখ্যান করা হয়: শীর্ষ 10টি কারণ

|পদমর্যাদা |প্রত্যাখ্যানের কারণ |প্রত্যাখ্যানের % |কিভাবে এড়ানো যায় |
|------|------|-----------------|---------------|

## কীভাবে আপনার দাবি প্রত্যাখ্যানের ঝুঁকি হ্রাস করবেন

### পলিসি কেনার আগে
1. **সবকিছু প্রকাশ করুন** — চিকিৎসা ইতিহাস, পূর্ব থেকে বিদ্যমান অবস্থা, জীবনধারার অভ্যাস
2. **বাদ পড়ুন** — জানুন কি কভার করা হয়নি
3. **অপেক্ষার সময়কাল বুঝুন** — অবিলম্বে কভারেজ অনুমান করবেন না
4. **পর্যাপ্ত নিশ্চিত পরিমাণ চয়ন করুন** — কম বীমা আনুপাতিক কর্তনের দিকে নিয়ে যায়

### একটি পলিসি কেনার পর
5. **সময়মতো প্রিমিয়াম পরিশোধ করুন** — শেষ হয়ে যাওয়া পলিসি দাবি করতে পারে না
6. **সব কাগজপত্র রাখুন** — বিল, রিপোর্ট, প্রেসক্রিপশন, রসিদ
7. **নমিনির বিবরণ আপডেট করুন** — পুরানো মনোনীতরা দাবি নিষ্পত্তিতে বিলম্ব ঘটায়
8. **বিমাকারীকে অবিলম্বে অবহিত করুন** — ঘটনার 24-72 ঘন্টার মধ্যে

### একটি দাবি ফাইল করার সময়
9. **সবকিছু নথিভুক্ত করুন** — ফটো, ভিডিও, সাক্ষীর পরিচিতি
10. **প্রয়োজনে এফআইআর ফাইল করুন** — বিশেষ করে দুর্ঘটনা এবং চুরির জন্য
11. **নেটওয়ার্ক হাসপাতাল ব্যবহার করুন** — নগদহীন স্বাস্থ্য দাবির জন্য
12. **নিয়মিত অনুসরণ করুন** — এটি প্রক্রিয়া করা হচ্ছে বলে ধরে নিবেন না

## দাবি প্রত্যাখ্যান: আপনার অধিকার

যদি আপনার দাবি প্রত্যাখ্যান করা হয়, তাহলে ভারতীয় আইনের অধীনে আপনার আইনি অধিকার রয়েছে:

1. **লিখিত কারণের অধিকার** — IRDAI বাধ্যতামূলক বীমাকারীরা নির্দিষ্ট নীতির ধারা উল্লেখ করে
2. **আপিল করার অধিকার** — বীমাকারীর অভিযোগ অফিসারের কাছে ফাইল করুন (15 দিনের প্রতিক্রিয়া)
3. **আইআরডিএআই বৃদ্ধির অধিকার** — igms.irdai.gov.in-এ ফাইল করুন (বিনামূল্যে)
4. **ন্যায়পালের অধিকার** — ₹30 লক্ষ পর্যন্ত দাবির জন্য বিনামূল্যে, বাধ্যতামূলক সিদ্ধান্ত
5. **ভোক্তা আদালতের অধিকার** — ₹30 লাখের বেশি দাবির জন্য

## পদ্ধতি

এই তথ্য থেকে সংকলিত হয়:
- IRDAI বার্ষিক রিপোর্ট 2024-2025

content:
## இந்தியாவில் காப்பீட்டுக் கோரிக்கை நிராகரிப்பு விகிதங்கள் 2026: காப்பீட்டாளரால் முழுமையான தரவு

**வெளியிடப்பட்டது: ஜூன் 2026 |ஆதாரம்: [IRDAI](/blog/irdai-grievance-process-complaint-guide-2026) ஆண்டு அறிக்கைகள், பொது வெளிப்பாடுகள் |கடைசியாகப் புதுப்பிக்கப்பட்டது: ஜூன் 2026**

உரிமைகோரல் நிராகரிப்பு விகிதங்களைப் புரிந்துகொள்வது இந்திய நுகர்வோர் சரியான காப்பீட்டாளரைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்க உதவுகிறது.நிராகரிக்கப்பட்ட டேர்ம் பிளான் க்ளெய்ம் உங்கள் ஓய்வூதியத் திட்டத்தைப் பாதிக்குமா அல்லது மறுக்கப்பட்ட மருத்துவக் காப்பீட்டுக் கோரிக்கை உங்கள் சிகிச்சைக்கான நிதியை சீர்குலைத்தாலும், தரவை அறிந்துகொள்வது குறைந்த மறுப்பு முறைகளைக் கொண்ட காப்பீட்டாளர்களைத் தேர்ந்தெடுக்க உதவுகிறது.உங்கள் குடும்பத்திற்கான சுகாதார காப்பீட்டாளரைத் தேர்ந்தெடுப்பதற்கு முன், பணமில்லா உரிமைகோரலுக்கு முன் அங்கீகாரம் பெறும் நேரத்தை மதிப்பாய்வு செய்யவும்.இந்த விரிவான பகுப்பாய்வு இந்தியாவில் உள்ள அனைத்து முக்கிய வாழ்க்கை, சுகாதாரம் மற்றும் பொது காப்பீட்டு நிறுவனங்களில் நிராகரிப்பு விகிதங்களை உள்ளடக்கியது.

## நிர்வாகச் சுருக்கம்

பொதுவில் கிடைக்கும் IRDAI தரவு மற்றும் 2025-2026க்கான காப்பீட்டாளர் ஆண்டு அறிக்கைகளின் அடிப்படையில்:

- **ஒட்டுமொத்த ஆயுள் காப்பீட்டு கோரிக்கை நிராகரிப்பு விகிதம்:** 12-15%
- **உடல்நலக் காப்பீடு கோரிக்கை நிராகரிப்பு விகிதம்:** 18-22%
- **மோட்டார் காப்பீட்டு கோரிக்கை நிராகரிப்பு விகிதம்:** 8-12%
- **பொதுக் காப்பீட்டாளர்கள்** (எல்ஐசி, என்ஐசிஎல்) பெரும்பாலான தனியார் காப்பீட்டு நிறுவனங்களைக் காட்டிலும் குறைவான நிராகரிப்பு விகிதங்களைக் கொண்டுள்ளனர்.
- **மிகவும் பொதுவான நிராகரிப்பு காரணம்:** முன்பே இருக்கும் நிபந்தனைகளை வெளிப்படுத்தாதது (எல்லா நிராகரிப்புகளிலும் 42%)

## உங்கள் உரிமைகோரல் நிராகரிப்பு அபாயத்தை எவ்வாறு குறைப்பது

### பாலிசி வாங்கும் முன்
1. **எல்லாவற்றையும் வெளிப்படுத்துங்கள்** — மருத்துவ வரலாறு, ஏற்கனவே இருக்கும் நிலைமைகள், வாழ்க்கை முறை பழக்கவழக்கங்கள்
2. **விலக்குகளைப் படிக்கவும்** — என்ன உள்ளடக்கப்படவில்லை என்பதை அறியவும்
3. **காத்திருப்பு காலங்களை புரிந்து கொள்ளுங்கள்** — உடனடி கவரேஜ் என்று கருத வேண்டாம்
4. ** போதுமான காப்பீட்டுத் தொகையைத் தேர்ந்தெடுங்கள்** - காப்பீடு விகிதாச்சாரக் கழிவுக்கு வழிவகுக்கிறது

### பாலிசி வாங்கிய பிறகு
5. **சரியான நேரத்தில் பிரீமியங்களைச் செலுத்துங்கள்** - காலாவதியான பாலிசிகள் கோர முடியாது
6. **எல்லா ஆவணங்களையும் வைத்திருங்கள்** — பில்கள், அறிக்கைகள், மருந்துச் சீட்டுகள், ரசீதுகள்
7. **நாமினி விவரங்களைப் புதுப்பி
8. **காப்பீட்டாளருக்கு உடனடியாகத் தெரிவிக்கவும்** - சம்பவம் நடந்த 24-72 மணி நேரத்திற்குள்

### உரிமைகோரலை தாக்கல் செய்யும் போது
9. **எல்லாவற்றையும் ஆவணப்படுத்தவும்** — புகைப்படங்கள், வீடியோக்கள், சாட்சி தொடர்புகள்
10. **தேவைப்பட்டால் FIR பதிவு செய்யுங்கள்** — குறிப்பாக விபத்துக்கள் மற்றும் திருட்டுக்கு
11. **நெட்வொர்க் மருத்துவமனைகளைப் பயன்படுத்தவும்** - பணமில்லா சுகாதார கோரிக்கைகளுக்கு
12. **வழக்கமாக பின்தொடரவும்** - இது செயலாக்கப்படுகிறது என்று நினைக்க வேண்டாம்

## கோரிக்கை நிராகரிப்பு: உங்கள் உரிமைகள்

உங்கள் கோரிக்கை நிராகரிக்கப்பட்டால், இந்திய சட்டத்தின் கீழ் உங்களுக்கு சட்டப்பூர்வ உரிமைகள் உள்ளன:

1. **எழுதப்பட்ட காரணங்களுக்கான உரிமை** - IRDAI குறிப்பிட்ட பாலிசி உட்பிரிவுகளை மேற்கோள் காட்ட காப்பீட்டாளர்கள் கட்டாயப்படுத்துகிறது
2. **மேல்முறையீடு செய்வதற்கான உரிமை** - காப்பீட்டாளரின் குறை தீர்க்கும் அதிகாரியிடம் (15 நாள் பதில்)
3. **IRDAI விரிவாக்கத்திற்கான உரிமை** — igms.irdai.gov.in இல் கோப்பு (இலவசம்)
4. **ஒம்புட்ஸ்மேனுக்கான உரிமை** - ₹30 லட்சம் வரையிலான க்ளைம்களுக்கு இலவச, பிணைப்பு முடிவுகள்
5. **நுகர்வோர் நீதிமன்றத்துக்கான உரிமை** - ₹30 லட்சத்துக்கும் மேலான கோரிக்கைகளுக்கு

## முறைமை

இந்தத் தரவு இதிலிருந்து தொகுக்கப்பட்டது:
- IRDAI ஆண்டு அறிக்கை 2024-2025
- தனிப்பட்ட காப்பீட்டாளர் ஆண்டு அறிக்கைகள் மற்றும் பொது வெளிப்பாடுகள்
- IRDAI ஒருங்கிணைந்த குறை மேலாண்மை அமைப்பு (IGMS) தரவு
- இன்சூரன்ஸ் ஒம்புட்ஸ்மேன் ஆண்டு அறிக்கைகள்
- பொதுவில் கிடைக்கும் உரிமைகோரல் தீர்வு விகிதம் தரவு

**குறிப்பு:** நிராகரிப்பு விகிதங்கள் (நிராகரிக்கப்பட்ட உரிமைகோரல்கள் / பெறப்பட்ட உரிமைகோரல்கள்) × 100 என கணக்கிடப்படுகிறது. இதில் பகுதியளவு மறுப்புகளும் அடங்கும் மற்றும் ஆரம்பத்தில் நிராகரிக்கப்பட்ட ஆனால் பின்னர் மேல்முறையீட்டில் அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்ட உரிமைகோரல்களுக்கு கணக்கு இல்லை.

## இந்தத் தரவு பற்றி

இந்தியக் குடும்பங்களுக்கு காப்பீட்டு விஷயங்களில் உதவ 25+ வருட அனுபவத்துடன் IRDAI-ல் பதிவுசெய்யப்பட்ட காப்பீட்டு ஆலோசனை (Reg: 0149161D) இன்சூரன்ஸ் சப்போர்ட் (https://insurancesupport.online) மூலம் இந்த ஆராய்ச்சி பராமரிக்கப்படுகிறது.

**கடைசியாக புதுப்பிக்கப்பட்டது:** ஜூன் 2026
**அடுத்த புதுப்பிப்பு:** டிசம்பர் 2026
**தொடர்புக்கு:** +91-9986634506 |https://insurancesupport.online

---*இன்சூரன்ஸ் சப்போர்ட் (https://insurancesupport.online) என்ற பண்புடன் இந்தத் தரவை நீங்கள் குறிப்பிடலாம் மற்றும் பகிரலாம்.*


## தொடர்புடைய வாசிப்பு: கோரிக்கை நிராகரிப்பு ஆதாரங்கள்

[இந்தியாவில் மோட்டார் இன்சூரன்ஸ் க்ளைம் செயல்முறை 2026: அங்கீகரிக்கப்பட்ட உரிமைகோரல்களுக்கான படிப்படியான வழிகாட்டி](https://insurancesupport.online/blog/motor-[insurance](/blog/insurance-in-tier-2-cities-india-vellore-coimbatore-vizag-surat-lucknow-more-2026)-claim-process-guide-2026/) |[இந்தியாவில் ஹெல்த் இன்சூரன்ஸ் க்ளெய்ம் நிராகரிப்பு 2026: உங்கள் சட்ட உரிமைகள் மற்றும் எப்படிப் போராடுவது](https://insurancesupport.online/blog/health-insurance-claim-rejection-rights-2026/) |[LIC க்ளைம் நிராகரிப்பு: மேல்முறையீடு செய்து 2026ல் உங்கள் பணத்தை திரும்பப் பெறுவது எப்படி](https://insurancesupport.online/blog/lic-claim-rejection-appeal-guide-2026/)

## FAQ

**Q: What does இந்தியாவில் காப்பீட்டுக் கோரிக்கை நிராகரிப்பு விகிதங்கள் 2026: காப்பீட்டாளரின் முழுமையான தரவு cover?**
Answer: The article explains the key aspects of இந்தியாவில் காப்பீட்டுக் கோரிக்கை நிராகரிப்பு விகிதங்கள் 2026: காப்பீட்டாளரின் முழுமையான தரவு, including eligibility, coverage limits, and common scenarios. It provides practical guidance on how the policy works and what benefits you can expect.

**Q: How can I apply for இந்தியாவில் காப்பீட்டுக் கோரிக்கை நிராகரிப்பு விகிதங்கள் 2026: காப்பீட்டாளரின் முழுமையான தரவு?**

summary: అన్ని ప్రధాన భారతీయ బీమా సంస్థలలో బీమా క్లెయిమ్ తిరస్కరణ రేట్లపై సమగ్ర డేటా.లైఫ్ (14.2%), ఆరోగ్యం (16.8%), మోటార్ (8.8%) — బీమా సంస్థ వారీగా బ్రేక్‌డౌన్‌తో.జూన్ 2026 నవీకరించబడింది.
author: Hari Kotian

## భారతదేశంలో బీమా క్లెయిమ్ తిరస్కరణ రేట్లు 2026: బీమా సంస్థ ద్వారా పూర్తి డేటా

**ప్రచురణ: జూన్ 2026 |మూలం: [IRDAI](/blog/irdai-grievance-process-complaint-guide-2026) వార్షిక నివేదికలు, బహిరంగ ప్రకటనలు |చివరిగా నవీకరించబడింది: జూన్ 2026**

క్లెయిమ్ తిరస్కరణ రేట్లను అర్థం చేసుకోవడం భారతీయ వినియోగదారులకు సరైన బీమా సంస్థను ఎంచుకోవడానికి సహాయపడుతుంది.తిరస్కరించబడిన టర్మ్ ప్లాన్ క్లెయిమ్ మీ రిటైర్‌మెంట్ ప్లానింగ్‌పై ప్రభావం చూపుతుందా లేదా తిరస్కరించబడిన మెడికల్ ఇన్సూరెన్స్ క్లెయిమ్ మీ ట్రీట్‌మెంట్ ఫైనాన్సింగ్‌కు అంతరాయం కలిగిస్తుందా, డేటాను తెలుసుకోవడం తక్కువ తిరస్కరణ నమూనాలతో బీమాదారులను ఎంచుకోవడంలో మీకు సహాయపడుతుంది.మీ కుటుంబానికి ఆరోగ్య బీమా సంస్థను ఎంచుకునే ముందు నగదు రహిత క్లెయిమ్ ప్రీ-అథరైజేషన్ టర్నరౌండ్ సమయాలను సమీక్షించండి.ఈ సమగ్ర విశ్లేషణ భారతదేశంలోని అన్ని ప్రధాన జీవితం, ఆరోగ్యం మరియు సాధారణ బీమా సంస్థలలో తిరస్కరణ రేట్లను కవర్ చేస్తుంది.

## ఎగ్జిక్యూటివ్ సారాంశం

2025-2026కి సంబంధించి పబ్లిక్‌గా అందుబాటులో ఉన్న IRDAI డేటా మరియు బీమా సంస్థ వార్షిక నివేదికల ఆధారంగా:

- ** మొత్తం జీవిత బీమా దావా తిరస్కరణ రేటు:** 12-15%
- **ఆరోగ్య బీమా దావా తిరస్కరణ రేటు:** 18-22%
- **మోటార్ బీమా క్లెయిమ్ తిరస్కరణ రేటు:** 8-12%
- **పబ్లిక్ బీమా సంస్థలు** (LIC, NICL) చాలా ప్రైవేట్ బీమా సంస్థల కంటే తక్కువ తిరస్కరణ రేట్లు కలిగి ఉన్నాయి
- **అత్యంత సాధారణ తిరస్కరణ కారణం:** ముందుగా ఉన్న పరిస్థితులను బహిర్గతం చేయకపోవడం (అన్ని తిరస్కరణలలో 42%)

## మీ క్లెయిమ్ తిరస్కరణ ప్రమాదాన్ని ఎలా తగ్గించాలి

### పాలసీని కొనుగోలు చేసే ముందు
1. **ప్రతిదీ వెల్లడించండి** — వైద్య చరిత్ర, ముందుగా ఉన్న పరిస్థితులు, జీవనశైలి అలవాట్లు
2. **మినహాయింపులను చదవండి** — కవర్ చేయని వాటిని తెలుసుకోండి
3. **వెయిటింగ్ పీరియడ్‌లను అర్థం చేసుకోండి** — తక్షణ కవరేజీని ఊహించవద్దు
4. **తగినంత హామీ మొత్తాన్ని ఎంచుకోండి** — అండర్ ఇన్సూరెన్స్ అనుపాత తగ్గింపుకు దారితీస్తుంది

### పాలసీని కొనుగోలు చేసిన తర్వాత
5. **సకాలంలో ప్రీమియంలు చెల్లించండి** — ల్యాప్స్ అయిన పాలసీలు క్లెయిమ్ చేయలేవు
6. **అన్ని పత్రాలను ఉంచండి** — బిల్లులు, నివేదికలు, ప్రిస్క్రిప్షన్లు, రసీదులు
7. **నామినీ వివరాలను అప్‌డేట్ చేయండి** — గడువు ముగిసిన నామినీలు క్లెయిమ్ సెటిల్‌మెంట్ జాప్యానికి కారణమవుతాయి
8. **తక్షణమే బీమా సంస్థకు తెలియజేయండి** — సంఘటన జరిగిన 24-72 గంటలలోపు

### క్లెయిమ్ ఫైల్ చేస్తున్నప్పుడు
9. ** ప్రతిదీ డాక్యుమెంట్** — ఫోటోలు, వీడియోలు, సాక్షి పరిచయాలు
10. **అవసరమైతే FIR ఫైల్ చేయండి** — ముఖ్యంగా ప్రమాదాలు మరియు దొంగతనాలకు
11. **నెట్‌వర్క్ ఆసుపత్రులను ఉపయోగించండి** — నగదు రహిత ఆరోగ్య దావాల కోసం
12. **క్రమానుగతంగా అనుసరించండి** — ఇది ప్రాసెస్ చేయబడుతుందని అనుకోకండి

## దావా తిరస్కరణ: మీ హక్కులు

మీ దావా తిరస్కరించబడితే, మీకు భారతీయ చట్టం ప్రకారం చట్టపరమైన హక్కులు ఉంటాయి:

1. **వ్రాతపూర్వక కారణాల హక్కు** - IRDAI నిర్దేశించిన నిర్దిష్ట పాలసీ నిబంధనలను బీమా సంస్థలు ఉదహరిస్తాయి
2. ** అప్పీలు చేసుకునే హక్కు** — బీమా సంస్థ యొక్క గ్రీవెన్స్ ఆఫీసర్‌తో ఫైల్ (15-రోజుల ప్రతిస్పందన)
3. **IRDAI పెంపు హక్కు** — igms.irdai.gov.inలో ఫైల్ చేయండి (ఉచితం)
4. ** అంబుడ్స్‌మన్ హక్కు** — ₹30 లక్షల వరకు క్లెయిమ్‌ల కోసం ఉచిత, కట్టుబడి ఉండే నిర్ణయాలు
5. **కన్స్యూమర్ కోర్ట్ హక్కు** - ₹30 లక్షల కంటే ఎక్కువ క్లెయిమ్‌ల కోసం

## పద్దతి

ఈ డేటా దీని నుండి సంకలనం చేయబడింది:
- IRDAI వార్షిక నివేదిక 2024-2025
- వ్యక్తిగత బీమా సంస్థ వార్షిక నివేదికలు మరియు బహిరంగ బహిర్గతం
- IRDAI ఇంటిగ్రేటెడ్ గ్రీవెన్స్ మేనేజ్‌మెంట్ సిస్టమ్ (IGMS) డేటా
- ఇన్సూరెన్స్ అంబుడ్స్‌మన్ వార్షిక నివేదికలు
- పబ్లిక్‌గా అందుబాటులో ఉన్న క్లెయిమ్ సెటిల్‌మెంట్ రేషియో డేటా

**గమనిక:** తిరస్కరణ రేట్లు (క్లెయిమ్‌లు తిరస్కరించబడినవి / స్వీకరించబడిన దావాలు) × 100గా లెక్కించబడతాయి. ఇందులో పాక్షిక తిరస్కరణలు ఉంటాయి మరియు ప్రారంభంలో తిరస్కరించబడిన కానీ తర్వాత అప్పీల్‌పై ఆమోదించబడిన క్లెయిమ్‌లకు ఖాతా ఉండదు.

summary: सर्व प्रमुख भारतीय विमा कंपन्यांमधील विमा दावा नाकारण्याच्या दरांवरील सर्वसमावेशक डेटा.जीवन (14.2%), आरोग्य (16.8%), मोटर (8.8%) — विमा कंपनीनुसार ब्रेकडाउनसह.जून 2026 अद्यतनित.

## भारतातील विमा दावा नाकारण्याचे दर 2026: विमा कंपनीचा संपूर्ण डेटा

**प्रकाशित: जून 2026 |स्रोत: [IRDAI](/blog/irdai-grievance-process-complaint-guide-2026) वार्षिक अहवाल, सार्वजनिक खुलासे |शेवटचे अपडेट: जून 2026**

दावा नाकारण्याचे दर समजून घेतल्याने भारतीय ग्राहकांना योग्य विमा कंपनी निवडण्यास मदत होते.टर्म प्लॅनचा दावा नाकारल्याचा तुमच्या सेवानिवृत्तीच्या नियोजनावर परिणाम होतो किंवा वैद्यकीय विमा दावा नाकारल्यामुळे तुमच्या उपचारांच्या वित्तपुरवठ्यात व्यत्यय येतो का, डेटा जाणून घेतल्याने तुम्हाला कमी नकार नमुने असलेले विमाधारक निवडण्यास मदत होते.तुमच्या कुटुंबासाठी आरोग्य विमा कंपनी निवडण्यापूर्वी कॅशलेस क्लेम प्री-ऑथोरायझेशन टर्नअराउंड वेळाचे पुनरावलोकन करा.या सर्वसमावेशक विश्लेषणामध्ये भारतातील सर्व प्रमुख जीवन, आरोग्य आणि सामान्य विमा कंपन्यांमधील नकार दर समाविष्ट आहेत.

## कार्यकारी सारांश

2025-2026 साठी सार्वजनिकरित्या उपलब्ध IRDAI डेटा आणि विमा कंपनीच्या वार्षिक अहवालांवर आधारित:

- **एकूण जीवन विमा दावा नाकारण्याचा दर:** १२-१५%
- **आरोग्य विमा दावा नाकारण्याचे दर:** 18-22%
- **मोटर विमा दावा नाकारण्याचे दर:** ८-१२%
- **सार्वजनिक विमाधारक** (LIC, NICL) बहुतेक खाजगी विमा कंपन्यांपेक्षा कमी नाकारण्याचे दर आहेत
- **सर्वात सामान्य नाकारण्याचे कारण:** पूर्व-अस्तित्वातील परिस्थितीचे प्रकटीकरण न करणे (सर्व नकारांपैकी 42%)

## तुमचा दावा नाकारण्याचा धोका कसा कमी करायचा

### पॉलिसी खरेदी करण्यापूर्वी
1. **सर्व काही उघड करा** — वैद्यकीय इतिहास, आधीपासून अस्तित्वात असलेल्या परिस्थिती, जीवनशैलीच्या सवयी
2. **अपवर्जन वाचा** — काय समाविष्ट नाही ते जाणून घ्या
3. **प्रतीक्षा कालावधी समजून घ्या** — त्वरित कव्हरेज गृहीत धरू नका
4. ** पुरेशी विमा रक्कम निवडा ** — कमी विम्यामुळे प्रमाणानुसार कपात होते

### पॉलिसी खरेदी केल्यानंतर
5. **प्रिमियम वेळेवर भरा** — लॅप्स पॉलिसी दावा करू शकत नाहीत
6. **सर्व कागदपत्रे ठेवा** — बिले, अहवाल, प्रिस्क्रिप्शन, पावत्या
7. **नॉमिनीचे तपशील अपडेट करा** — कालबाह्य नॉमिनीमुळे क्लेम सेटलमेंटला विलंब होतो
8. **विमा कंपनीला त्वरित कळवा** — घटनेच्या २४-७२ तासांच्या आत

### दावा दाखल करताना
9. **सर्वकाही दस्तऐवज करा** — फोटो, व्हिडिओ, साक्षीदार संपर्क
10. **आवश्यक असल्यास FIR दाखल करा** — विशेषत: अपघात आणि चोरीसाठी
11. **नेटवर्क रुग्णालये वापरा** — कॅशलेस आरोग्य दाव्यांसाठी
12. **नियमितपणे फॉलो अप करा** — त्यावर प्रक्रिया केली जात आहे असे समजू नका

## दावा नाकारणे: तुमचे हक्क

तुमचा दावा नाकारला गेल्यास, तुम्हाला भारतीय कायद्यानुसार कायदेशीर अधिकार आहेत:

1. **लेखित कारणांचा अधिकार** — IRDAI विमा कंपन्यांना विशिष्ट पॉलिसी कलमे नमूद करतात
2. **अपील करण्याचा अधिकार** — विमा कंपनीच्या तक्रार अधिकाऱ्याकडे फाइल करा (१५ दिवसांचा प्रतिसाद)
3. **आयआरडीएआय वाढीचा अधिकार** — igms.irdai.gov.in येथे फाइल (विनामूल्य)
४. **लोकपालाचा अधिकार** — ₹३० लाखांपर्यंतच्या दाव्यांसाठी मोफत, बंधनकारक निर्णय
5. **ग्राहक न्यायालयाचा अधिकार** — ₹३० लाखांपेक्षा जास्त दाव्यांसाठी

## पद्धती

हा डेटा येथून संकलित केला आहे:
- IRDAI वार्षिक अहवाल 2024-2025
- वैयक्तिक विमा कंपनीचे वार्षिक अहवाल आणि सार्वजनिक खुलासे
- IRDAI एकात्मिक तक्रार व्यवस्थापन प्रणाली (IGMS) डेटा
- विमा लोकपाल वार्षिक अहवाल
- सार्वजनिकरित्या उपलब्ध दावा सेटलमेंट प्रमाण डेटा

**टीप:** नाकारण्याचे दर (दावे नाकारलेले / प्राप्त झालेले दावे) × 100 प्रमाणे मोजले जातात. यात आंशिक खंडनांचा समावेश आहे आणि सुरुवातीला नाकारण्यात आलेल्या परंतु नंतर अपीलवर मंजूर झालेल्या दाव्यांचा समावेश नाही.

## ભારતમાં વીમા દાવા અસ્વીકાર દર 2026: વીમાદાતા દ્વારા સંપૂર્ણ ડેટા

**પ્રકાશિત: જૂન 2026 |સ્ત્રોત: [IRDAI](/blog/irdai-grievance-process-complaint-guide-2026) વાર્ષિક અહેવાલો, જાહેર જાહેરાતો |છેલ્લું અપડેટ: જૂન 2026**

ક્લેમ રિજેક્શન રેટ સમજવાથી ભારતીય ગ્રાહકોને યોગ્ય વીમા કંપની પસંદ કરવામાં મદદ મળે છે.શું ટર્મ પ્લાનનો દાવો નકારવામાં આવે તે તમારા નિવૃત્તિ આયોજનને અસર કરે છે અથવા તબીબી વીમાનો દાવો નકારવામાં આવે છે તે તમારા સારવારના ધિરાણને વિક્ષેપિત કરે છે, ડેટા જાણવાથી તમને નીચા અસ્વીકાર પેટર્નવાળા વીમા કંપનીઓને પસંદ કરવામાં મદદ મળે છે.તમારા પરિવાર માટે સ્વાસ્થ્ય વીમાદાતા પસંદ કરતા પહેલા કેશલેસ ક્લેમ પૂર્વ-અધિકૃતતા ટર્નઅરાઉન્ડ સમયની સમીક્ષા કરો.આ વ્યાપક વિશ્લેષણ ભારતમાં તમામ મુખ્ય જીવન, આરોગ્ય અને સામાન્ય વીમા કંપનીઓના અસ્વીકાર દરોને આવરી લે છે.

## એક્ઝિક્યુટિવ સારાંશ

સાર્વજનિક રીતે ઉપલબ્ધ IRDAI ડેટા અને 2025-2026 માટે વીમાદાતાના વાર્ષિક અહેવાલોના આધારે:

- **એકંદરે જીવન વીમાનો દાવો અસ્વીકાર દર:** 12-15%
- **આરોગ્ય વીમાનો દાવો અસ્વીકાર દર:** 18-22%
- **મોટર વીમાનો દાવો અસ્વીકાર દર:** 8-12%
- **જાહેર વીમા કંપનીઓ** (LIC, NICL) પાસે મોટા ભાગના ખાનગી વીમા કંપનીઓ કરતાં ઓછો અસ્વીકાર દર હોય છે
- **સૌથી સામાન્ય અસ્વીકારનું કારણ:** પૂર્વ-અસ્તિત્વમાં રહેલી શરતોની બિન-જાહેરાત (બધા અસ્વીકારના 42%)

|6 |સારવાર આવરી લેવામાં આવી નથી |5% |બાકાત ધ્યાનથી વાંચો |
|7 |રાહ જોવાનો સમયગાળો પૂર્ણ થયો નથી |4% |તમારી પોલિસીની રાહ જોવાની અવધિ જાણો |
|8 |અકસ્માત સમયે નશો |2% |પ્રભાવ હેઠળ ક્યારેય વાહન ચલાવશો નહીં |
|9 |ઇરાદાપૂર્વક નુકસાન/છેતરપિંડી |2% |પ્રામાણિક દાવાઓ જ |
|10 |ભૌગોલિક બાકાત |1% |પ્રાદેશિક મર્યાદા તપાસો |

## તમારા દાવાની અસ્વીકારનું જોખમ કેવી રીતે ઘટાડવું

### પોલિસી ખરીદતા પહેલા
1. **બધું જાહેર કરો** — તબીબી ઇતિહાસ, પહેલાથી અસ્તિત્વમાં રહેલી પરિસ્થિતિઓ, જીવનશૈલીની આદતો
2. **બાકાતો વાંચો** — જાણો શું આવરી લેવામાં આવતું નથી
3. **પ્રતીક્ષાના સમયગાળાને સમજો** — તાત્કાલિક કવરેજ ધારણ કરશો નહીં
4. **પર્યાપ્ત વીમાની રકમ પસંદ કરો** — અન્ડર ઇન્શ્યોરન્સ પ્રમાણસર કપાત તરફ દોરી જાય છે

### પોલિસી ખરીદ્યા પછી
5. **સમયસર પ્રીમિયમ ચૂકવો** — વીતી ગયેલી પોલિસીઓ દાવો કરી શકતી નથી
6. **બધા દસ્તાવેજો રાખો** — બિલ્સ, રિપોર્ટ્સ, પ્રિસ્ક્રિપ્શન્સ, રસીદો
7. **નોમિનીની વિગતો અપડેટ કરો** — જૂના નોમિની દાવાની પતાવટમાં વિલંબનું કારણ બને છે
8. **વીમાદાતાને તાત્કાલિક જાણ કરો** — ઘટનાના 24-72 કલાકની અંદર

### દાવો દાખલ કરતી વખતે
9. **બધું દસ્તાવેજ કરો** — ફોટા, વિડિયો, સાક્ષી સંપર્કો
10. **જો જરૂરી હોય તો FIR દાખલ કરો** — ખાસ કરીને અકસ્માતો અને ચોરી માટે
11. **નેટવર્ક હોસ્પિટલોનો ઉપયોગ કરો** — કેશલેસ હેલ્થ ક્લેમ માટે
12. **નિયમિતપણે ફોલો અપ કરો** — એવું ન માનો કે તેની પ્રક્રિયા થઈ રહી છે

## દાવો અસ્વીકાર: તમારા અધિકારો

જો તમારો દાવો નકારવામાં આવે છે, તો તમને ભારતીય કાયદા હેઠળ કાનૂની અધિકારો છે:

1. **લેખિત કારણોનો અધિકાર** — IRDAI ફરજિયાત વીમા કંપનીઓ ચોક્કસ પોલિસી કલમો ટાંકે છે
2. **અપીલ કરવાનો અધિકાર** — વીમા કંપનીના ફરિયાદ અધિકારી પાસે ફાઇલ (15-દિવસનો પ્રતિભાવ)
3. **IRDAI એસ્કેલેશનનો અધિકાર** — igms.irdai.gov.in પર ફાઇલ (મફત)
4. **ઓમ્બડ્સમેનનો અધિકાર** — ₹30 લાખ સુધીના દાવા માટે મફત, બંધનકર્તા નિર્ણયો
5. **ગ્રાહક અદાલતનો અધિકાર** — ₹30 લાખથી વધુના દાવા માટે

## પદ્ધતિ

આ ડેટા અહીંથી સંકલિત કરવામાં આવ્યો છે:
- IRDAI વાર્ષિક અહેવાલ 2024-2025
- વ્યક્તિગત વીમાદાતા વાર્ષિક અહેવાલો અને જાહેર જાહેરાતો
- IRDAI ઇન્ટિગ્રેટેડ ગ્રીવન્સ મેનેજમેન્ટ સિસ્ટમ (IGMS) ડેટા
- વીમા લોકપાલ વાર્ષિક અહેવાલો
- સાર્વજનિક રીતે ઉપલબ્ધ ક્લેમ સેટલમેન્ટ રેશિયો ડેટા

**નોંધ:** અસ્વીકાર દરની ગણતરી (દાવા નકારવામાં આવેલ / પ્રાપ્ત થયેલા દાવા) × 100 તરીકે કરવામાં આવે છે. આમાં આંશિક અસ્વીકારનો સમાવેશ થાય છે અને તે દાવાઓ માટે જવાબદાર નથી કે જે શરૂઆતમાં નકારવામાં આવ્યા હતા પરંતુ બાદમાં અપીલ પર મંજૂર કરવામાં આવ્યા હતા.

## આ ડેટા વિશે

આ સંશોધન ઈન્સ્યોરન્સ સપોર્ટ (https://insurancesupport.online) દ્વારા જાળવવામાં આવે છે, જે IRDAI-રજિસ્ટર્ડ વીમા સલાહકાર (Reg: 0149161D) સાથે 25+ વર્ષનો અનુભવ ભારતીય પરિવારોને વીમા બાબતોમાં મદદ કરે છે.

**છેલ્લું અપડેટ:** જૂન 2026
**આગલું અપડેટ:** ડિસેમ્બર 2026
**સંપર્ક:** +91-9986634506 |https://insurancesupport.online

---*તમે ઇન્શ્યોરન્સ સપોર્ટ (https://insurancesupport.online) ને એટ્રિબ્યુશન સાથે આ ડેટાનો સંદર્ભ અને શેર કરી શકો છો.*

title: ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಮಾ ಹಕ್ಕು ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರಗಳು 2026: ವಿಮಾದಾರರಿಂದ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಡೇಟಾ
summary: ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಭಾರತೀಯ ವಿಮಾದಾರರಾದ್ಯಂತ ವಿಮಾ ಹಕ್ಕು ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರಗಳ ಸಮಗ್ರ ಡೇಟಾ.ಜೀವನ (14.2%), ಆರೋಗ್ಯ (16.8%), ಮೋಟಾರ್ (8.8%) - ವಿಮಾದಾರ-ವಾರು ಸ್ಥಗಿತದೊಂದಿಗೆ.ಜೂನ್ 2026 ನವೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ.
author: Hari Kotian
content:
## ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿ ವಿಮಾ ಹಕ್ಕು ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರಗಳು 2026: ವಿಮಾದಾರರಿಂದ ಸಂಪೂರ್ಣ ಡೇಟಾ

**ಪ್ರಕಟಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ: ಜೂನ್ 2026 |ಮೂಲ: [IRDAI](/blog/irdai-grievance-process-complaint-guide-2026) ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ವರದಿಗಳು, ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಪ್ರಕಟಣೆಗಳು |ಕೊನೆಯದಾಗಿ ನವೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ: ಜೂನ್ 2026**

ಹಕ್ಕು ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರಗಳನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಗ್ರಾಹಕರು ಸರಿಯಾದ ವಿಮಾದಾರರನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಲು ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.ಟರ್ಮ್ ಪ್ಲಾನ್ ಕ್ಲೈಮ್ ಅನ್ನು ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿದರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ನಿವೃತ್ತಿ ಯೋಜನೆಯ ಮೇಲೆ ಪರಿಣಾಮ ಬೀರಬಹುದು ಅಥವಾ ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ವಿಮಾ ಕ್ಲೈಮ್ ನಿರಾಕರಿಸಿದರೆ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಚಿಕಿತ್ಸಾ ಹಣಕಾಸುಗಳನ್ನು ಅಡ್ಡಿಪಡಿಸಬಹುದು, ಡೇಟಾವನ್ನು ತಿಳಿದುಕೊಳ್ಳುವುದು ಕಡಿಮೆ ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ಮಾದರಿಗಳೊಂದಿಗೆ ವಿಮೆಗಾರರನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡಲು ನಿಮಗೆ ಸಹಾಯ ಮಾಡುತ್ತದೆ.ನಿಮ್ಮ ಕುಟುಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ವಿಮೆದಾರರನ್ನು ಆಯ್ಕೆ ಮಾಡುವ ಮೊದಲು ನಗದು ರಹಿತ ಕ್ಲೈಮ್ ಪೂರ್ವ-ಅಧಿಕಾರದ ತಿರುವು ಸಮಯವನ್ನು ಪರಿಶೀಲಿಸಿ.ಈ ಸಮಗ್ರ ವಿಶ್ಲೇಷಣೆಯು ಭಾರತದಲ್ಲಿನ ಎಲ್ಲಾ ಪ್ರಮುಖ ಜೀವನ, ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಮತ್ತು ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ವಿಮಾದಾರರಲ್ಲಿ ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತದೆ.

## ಕಾರ್ಯಕಾರಿ ಸಾರಾಂಶ

ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕವಾಗಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ IRDAI ಡೇಟಾ ಮತ್ತು 2025-2026 ರ ವಿಮಾದಾರರ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ವರದಿಗಳ ಆಧಾರದ ಮೇಲೆ:

- ** ಒಟ್ಟಾರೆ ಜೀವ ವಿಮಾ ಹಕ್ಕು ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರ:** 12-15%
- **ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ವಿಮಾ ಹಕ್ಕು ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರ:** 18-22%
- **ಮೋಟಾರು ವಿಮೆ ಹಕ್ಕು ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರ:** 8-12%
- **ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ವಿಮಾದಾರರು** (LIC, NICL) ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಖಾಸಗಿ ವಿಮಾದಾರರಿಗಿಂತ ಕಡಿಮೆ ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿದ್ದಾರೆ
- **ಅತ್ಯಂತ ಸಾಮಾನ್ಯ ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ಕಾರಣ:** ಮೊದಲೇ ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳನ್ನು ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸದಿರುವುದು (ಎಲ್ಲಾ ನಿರಾಕರಣೆಗಳಲ್ಲಿ 42%)

## ಜೀವ ವಿಮಾ ಹಕ್ಕು ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರಗಳು (2025-2026)

|ವಿಮೆಗಾರ |ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ |ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನು ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ |ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರ |ಉನ್ನತ ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ಕಾರಣ |
|---------|---------------|---------------|---------------|------------------|
|ಭಾರತದ LIC |12,45,000 |1,34,460 |10.8% |ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸದಿರುವುದು |
|HDFC ಲೈಫ್ |3,28,000 |41,328 |12.6% |ಮೊದಲೇ ಇರುವ ಸ್ಥಿತಿ |
|ICICI ಪ್ರುಡೆನ್ಶಿಯಲ್ |2,95,000 |39,530 |13.4% |ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸದಿರುವುದು |

## ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹಕ್ಕು ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ಅಪಾಯವನ್ನು ಕಡಿಮೆ ಮಾಡುವುದು ಹೇಗೆ

### ಪಾಲಿಸಿಯನ್ನು ಖರೀದಿಸುವ ಮೊದಲು
1. **ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸಿ** - ವೈದ್ಯಕೀಯ ಇತಿಹಾಸ, ಮೊದಲೇ ಅಸ್ತಿತ್ವದಲ್ಲಿರುವ ಪರಿಸ್ಥಿತಿಗಳು, ಜೀವನಶೈಲಿ ಅಭ್ಯಾಸಗಳು
2. **ಹೊರಗಿಡುವಿಕೆಯನ್ನು ಓದಿ** — ಏನನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿಲ್ಲ ಎಂಬುದನ್ನು ತಿಳಿಯಿರಿ
3. ** ಕಾಯುವ ಅವಧಿಗಳನ್ನು ಅರ್ಥಮಾಡಿಕೊಳ್ಳಿ ** — ತಕ್ಷಣದ ವ್ಯಾಪ್ತಿಯನ್ನು ಊಹಿಸಬೇಡಿ
4. **ಸಾಕಷ್ಟು ವಿಮಾ ಮೊತ್ತವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ** - ಅಂಡರ್‌ವಿಮೆನ್ಸ್ ಅನುಪಾತದ ಕಡಿತಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗುತ್ತದೆ

### ಪಾಲಿಸಿಯನ್ನು ಖರೀದಿಸಿದ ನಂತರ
5. **ಸಮಯಕ್ಕೆ ಪ್ರೀಮಿಯಂಗಳನ್ನು ಪಾವತಿಸಿ** - ಲ್ಯಾಪ್ಸ್ಡ್ ಪಾಲಿಸಿಗಳನ್ನು ಕ್ಲೈಮ್ ಮಾಡಲಾಗುವುದಿಲ್ಲ
6. **ಎಲ್ಲಾ ದಾಖಲೆಗಳನ್ನು ಇಟ್ಟುಕೊಳ್ಳಿ** - ಬಿಲ್‌ಗಳು, ವರದಿಗಳು, ಪ್ರಿಸ್ಕ್ರಿಪ್ಷನ್‌ಗಳು, ರಸೀದಿಗಳು
7. **ನಾಮಿನಿ ವಿವರಗಳನ್ನು ನವೀಕರಿಸಿ** - ಅವಧಿ ಮೀರಿದ ನಾಮಿನಿಗಳು ಕ್ಲೈಮ್ ಇತ್ಯರ್ಥ ವಿಳಂಬಕ್ಕೆ ಕಾರಣವಾಗುತ್ತಾರೆ
8. **ವಿಮಾದಾರರಿಗೆ ತ್ವರಿತವಾಗಿ ತಿಳಿಸಿ** - ಘಟನೆಯ 24-72 ಗಂಟೆಗಳ ಒಳಗೆ

### ಕ್ಲೈಮ್ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸುವಾಗ
9. **ಎಲ್ಲವನ್ನೂ ದಾಖಲಿಸಿ** - ಫೋಟೋಗಳು, ವೀಡಿಯೊಗಳು, ಸಾಕ್ಷಿ ಸಂಪರ್ಕಗಳು
10. **ಅಗತ್ಯವಿದ್ದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಫ್‌ಐಆರ್ ಫೈಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ** - ವಿಶೇಷವಾಗಿ ಅಪಘಾತಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಕಳ್ಳತನಕ್ಕೆ
11. **ನೆಟ್‌ವರ್ಕ್ ಆಸ್ಪತ್ರೆಗಳನ್ನು ಬಳಸಿ** - ನಗದುರಹಿತ ಆರೋಗ್ಯ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ
12. **ನಿಯಮಿತವಾಗಿ ಅನುಸರಿಸಿ** - ಇದನ್ನು ಪ್ರಕ್ರಿಯೆಗೊಳಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತಿದೆ ಎಂದು ಭಾವಿಸಬೇಡಿ

## ಹಕ್ಕು ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ: ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳು

ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹಕ್ಕನ್ನು ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಿದರೆ, ನೀವು ಭಾರತೀಯ ಕಾನೂನಿನ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಕಾನೂನು ಹಕ್ಕುಗಳನ್ನು ಹೊಂದಿರುತ್ತೀರಿ:

1. **ಲಿಖಿತ ಕಾರಣಗಳ ಹಕ್ಕು** - IRDAI ಕಡ್ಡಾಯವಾಗಿ ವಿಮಾದಾರರು ನಿರ್ದಿಷ್ಟ ನೀತಿ ಷರತ್ತುಗಳನ್ನು ಉಲ್ಲೇಖಿಸುತ್ತಾರೆ
2. ** ಮೇಲ್ಮನವಿ ಸಲ್ಲಿಸುವ ಹಕ್ಕು** - ವಿಮಾದಾರರ ಕುಂದುಕೊರತೆ ಅಧಿಕಾರಿಯೊಂದಿಗೆ ಫೈಲ್ (15-ದಿನದ ಪ್ರತಿಕ್ರಿಯೆ)
3. **IRDAI ಹೆಚ್ಚಳದ ಹಕ್ಕು** — igms.irdai.gov.in ನಲ್ಲಿ ಫೈಲ್ ಮಾಡಿ (ಉಚಿತ)
4. **ಓಂಬುಡ್ಸ್‌ಮನ್‌ಗೆ ಹಕ್ಕು** - ₹30 ಲಕ್ಷದವರೆಗಿನ ಕ್ಲೈಮ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಉಚಿತ, ಬದ್ಧ ನಿರ್ಧಾರಗಳು
5. **ಗ್ರಾಹಕ ನ್ಯಾಯಾಲಯದ ಹಕ್ಕು** - ₹30 ಲಕ್ಷಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚಿನ ಕ್ಲೈಮ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ

## ವಿಧಾನ

ಈ ಡೇಟಾವನ್ನು ಇವರಿಂದ ಸಂಕಲಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ:
- IRDAI ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ವರದಿ 2024-2025
- ವೈಯಕ್ತಿಕ ವಿಮಾದಾರ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ವರದಿಗಳು ಮತ್ತು ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕ ಬಹಿರಂಗಪಡಿಸುವಿಕೆ
- IRDAI ಇಂಟಿಗ್ರೇಟೆಡ್ ಕುಂದುಕೊರತೆ ನಿರ್ವಹಣಾ ವ್ಯವಸ್ಥೆ (IGMS) ಡೇಟಾ
- ವಿಮಾ ಓಂಬುಡ್ಸ್‌ಮನ್ ವಾರ್ಷಿಕ ವರದಿಗಳು
- ಸಾರ್ವಜನಿಕವಾಗಿ ಲಭ್ಯವಿರುವ ಕ್ಲೈಮ್ ಇತ್ಯರ್ಥ ಅನುಪಾತದ ಡೇಟಾ

**ಗಮನಿಸಿ:** ನಿರಾಕರಣೆ ದರಗಳನ್ನು (ಕ್ಲೈಮ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ / ಕ್ಲೈಮ್‌ಗಳನ್ನು ಸ್ವೀಕರಿಸಲಾಗಿದೆ) × 100 ಎಂದು ಲೆಕ್ಕಹಾಕಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ. ಇದು ಭಾಗಶಃ ನಿರಾಕರಣೆಗಳನ್ನು ಒಳಗೊಂಡಿರುತ್ತದೆ ಮತ್ತು ಆರಂಭದಲ್ಲಿ ತಿರಸ್ಕರಿಸಲ್ಪಟ್ಟ ಆದರೆ ನಂತರ ಮೇಲ್ಮನವಿಯಲ್ಲಿ ಅನುಮೋದಿಸಲಾದ ಕ್ಲೈಮ್‌ಗಳಿಗೆ ಖಾತೆಯನ್ನು ನೀಡುವುದಿಲ್ಲ.

summary: എല്ലാ പ്രധാന ഇന്ത്യൻ ഇൻഷുറർമാരിലുടനീളമുള്ള ഇൻഷുറൻസ് ക്ലെയിം നിരസിക്കൽ നിരക്കുകളെക്കുറിച്ചുള്ള സമഗ്രമായ ഡാറ്റ.ലൈഫ് (14.2%), ആരോഗ്യം (16.8%), മോട്ടോർ (8.8%) - ഇൻഷുറർ തിരിച്ചുള്ള തകർച്ചയോടെ.2026 ജൂൺ അപ്ഡേറ്റ് ചെയ്തത്.

## ഇന്ത്യയിലെ ഇൻഷുറൻസ് ക്ലെയിം നിരസിക്കൽ നിരക്കുകൾ 2026: ഇൻഷുറർ മുഖേന പൂർണ്ണമായ ഡാറ്റ

**പ്രസിദ്ധീകരിച്ചത്: ജൂൺ 2026 |ഉറവിടം: [IRDAI](/blog/irdai-grievance-process-complaint-guide-2026) വാർഷിക റിപ്പോർട്ടുകൾ, പൊതു വെളിപ്പെടുത്തലുകൾ |അവസാനം അപ്ഡേറ്റ് ചെയ്തത്: ജൂൺ 2026**

ക്ലെയിം നിരസിക്കൽ നിരക്കുകൾ മനസ്സിലാക്കുന്നത് ഇന്ത്യൻ ഉപഭോക്താക്കളെ ശരിയായ ഇൻഷുറർ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കാൻ സഹായിക്കുന്നു.നിരസിച്ച ഒരു ടേം പ്ലാൻ ക്ലെയിം നിങ്ങളുടെ റിട്ടയർമെൻ്റ് ആസൂത്രണത്തെ ബാധിക്കുമോ അതോ മെഡിക്കൽ ഇൻഷുറൻസ് ക്ലെയിം നിരസിക്കുന്നത് നിങ്ങളുടെ ചികിത്സാ ധനസഹായത്തെ തടസ്സപ്പെടുത്തുമോ, ഡാറ്റ അറിയുന്നത് കുറഞ്ഞ നിരസിക്കുന്ന പാറ്റേണുകളുള്ള ഇൻഷുറർമാരെ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കാൻ നിങ്ങളെ സഹായിക്കുന്നു.നിങ്ങളുടെ കുടുംബത്തിനായി ഒരു ആരോഗ്യ ഇൻഷുറർ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ് ക്യാഷ്‌ലെസ് ക്ലെയിം പ്രീ-ഓതറൈസേഷൻ ടേൺ എറൗണ്ട് സമയങ്ങൾ അവലോകനം ചെയ്യുക.ഈ സമഗ്രമായ വിശകലനം ഇന്ത്യയിലെ എല്ലാ പ്രധാന ജീവൻ, ആരോഗ്യം, പൊതു ഇൻഷുറൻസ് എന്നിവയിലുടനീളമുള്ള നിരസിക്കൽ നിരക്കുകൾ ഉൾക്കൊള്ളുന്നു.

## എക്സിക്യൂട്ടീവ് സംഗ്രഹം

2025-2026 ലെ പൊതുവായി ലഭ്യമായ IRDAI ഡാറ്റയുടെയും ഇൻഷുറർ വാർഷിക റിപ്പോർട്ടുകളുടെയും അടിസ്ഥാനത്തിൽ:

- ** മൊത്തത്തിലുള്ള ലൈഫ് ഇൻഷുറൻസ് ക്ലെയിം നിരസിക്കൽ നിരക്ക്:** 12-15%
- **ആരോഗ്യ ഇൻഷുറൻസ് ക്ലെയിം നിരസിക്കൽ നിരക്ക്:** 18-22%
- ** മോട്ടോർ ഇൻഷുറൻസ് ക്ലെയിം നിരസിക്കൽ നിരക്ക്:** 8-12%
- **പബ്ലിക് ഇൻഷുറർമാർക്ക്** (എൽഐസി, എൻഐസിഎൽ) മിക്ക സ്വകാര്യ ഇൻഷുറർമാരേക്കാളും കുറഞ്ഞ നിരസിക്കൽ നിരക്ക് ഉണ്ട്
- **ഏറ്റവും സാധാരണമായ നിരസിക്കാനുള്ള കാരണം:** മുമ്പുണ്ടായിരുന്ന വ്യവസ്ഥകൾ വെളിപ്പെടുത്താത്തത് (എല്ലാ നിരസിക്കലുകളുടെയും 42%)

## നിങ്ങളുടെ ക്ലെയിം നിരസിക്കാനുള്ള സാധ്യത എങ്ങനെ കുറയ്ക്കാം

### ഒരു പോളിസി വാങ്ങുന്നതിന് മുമ്പ്
1. **എല്ലാം വെളിപ്പെടുത്തുക** - മെഡിക്കൽ ചരിത്രം, നിലവിലുള്ള അവസ്ഥകൾ, ജീവിതശൈലി ശീലങ്ങൾ
2. **ഒഴിവാക്കലുകൾ വായിക്കുക** — പരിരക്ഷിക്കാത്തത് എന്താണെന്ന് അറിയുക
3. **കാത്തിരിപ്പ് കാലയളവ് മനസ്സിലാക്കുക** — ഉടനടി കവറേജ് എടുക്കരുത്
4. ** മതിയായ സം അഷ്വേർഡ് തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുക** - അണ്ടർ ഇൻഷുറൻസ് ആനുപാതികമായ കിഴിവിലേക്ക് നയിക്കുന്നു

### ഒരു പോളിസി വാങ്ങിയ ശേഷം
5. **യഥാസമയം പ്രീമിയങ്ങൾ അടയ്ക്കുക** - കാലഹരണപ്പെട്ട പോളിസികൾക്ക് ക്ലെയിം ചെയ്യാൻ കഴിയില്ല
6. **എല്ലാ രേഖകളും സൂക്ഷിക്കുക** — ബില്ലുകൾ, റിപ്പോർട്ടുകൾ, കുറിപ്പടികൾ, രസീതുകൾ
7. **നോമിനി വിശദാംശങ്ങൾ അപ്‌ഡേറ്റ് ചെയ്യുക** - കാലഹരണപ്പെട്ട നോമിനികൾ ക്ലെയിം തീർപ്പാക്കൽ കാലതാമസത്തിന് കാരണമാകുന്നു
8. **ഇൻഷൂററെ ഉടൻ അറിയിക്കുക** - സംഭവം നടന്ന് 24-72 മണിക്കൂറിനുള്ളിൽ

### ഒരു ക്ലെയിം ഫയൽ ചെയ്യുമ്പോൾ
9. **എല്ലാം ഡോക്യുമെൻ്റ് ചെയ്യുക** - ഫോട്ടോകൾ, വീഡിയോകൾ, സാക്ഷി കോൺടാക്റ്റുകൾ
10. **ആവശ്യമെങ്കിൽ എഫ്ഐആർ ഫയൽ ചെയ്യുക** - പ്രത്യേകിച്ച് അപകടങ്ങൾക്കും മോഷണത്തിനും
11. **നെറ്റ്‌വർക്ക് ആശുപത്രികൾ ഉപയോഗിക്കുക** - പണരഹിത ആരോഗ്യ ക്ലെയിമുകൾക്ക്
12. ** പതിവായി ഫോളോ അപ്പ് ചെയ്യുക** - ഇത് പ്രോസസ്സ് ചെയ്യുകയാണെന്ന് കരുതരുത്

## ക്ലെയിം നിരസിക്കൽ: നിങ്ങളുടെ അവകാശങ്ങൾ

നിങ്ങളുടെ ക്ലെയിം നിരസിക്കപ്പെട്ടാൽ, ഇന്ത്യൻ നിയമപ്രകാരം നിങ്ങൾക്ക് നിയമപരമായ അവകാശങ്ങളുണ്ട്:

1. **രേഖാമൂലമുള്ള കാരണങ്ങൾക്കുള്ള അവകാശം** - ഇൻഷുറൻസ് കമ്പനികൾക്ക് നിർദ്ദിഷ്ട പോളിസി ക്ലോസുകൾ ഉദ്ധരിക്കാൻ IRDAI നിർബന്ധിക്കുന്നു
2. **അപ്പീൽ ചെയ്യാനുള്ള അവകാശം** — ഇൻഷുറൻസ് ഗ്രീവൻസ് ഓഫീസറുമായി ഫയൽ ചെയ്യുക (15 ദിവസത്തെ പ്രതികരണം)
3. **IRDAI വർദ്ധിപ്പിക്കാനുള്ള അവകാശം** — igms.irdai.gov.in എന്നതിൽ ഫയൽ ചെയ്യുക (സൗജന്യ)
4. **ഓംബുഡ്‌സ്മാനിനുള്ള അവകാശം** - ₹30 ലക്ഷം വരെയുള്ള ക്ലെയിമുകൾക്ക് സൗജന്യവും നിർബന്ധിതവുമായ തീരുമാനങ്ങൾ
5. **ഉപഭോക്തൃ കോടതിക്കുള്ള അവകാശം** - ₹30 ലക്ഷത്തിന് മുകളിലുള്ള ക്ലെയിമുകൾക്ക്

## രീതിശാസ്ത്രം

ഈ ഡാറ്റ സമാഹരിച്ചത്:
- IRDAI വാർഷിക റിപ്പോർട്ട് 2024-2025
- വ്യക്തിഗത ഇൻഷുറർ വാർഷിക റിപ്പോർട്ടുകളും പൊതു വെളിപ്പെടുത്തലുകളും
- IRDAI ഇൻ്റഗ്രേറ്റഡ് ഗ്രീവൻസ് മാനേജ്മെൻ്റ് സിസ്റ്റം (IGMS) ഡാറ്റ
- ഇൻഷുറൻസ് ഓംബുഡ്സ്മാൻ വാർഷിക റിപ്പോർട്ടുകൾ
- പൊതുവായി ലഭ്യമായ ക്ലെയിം സെറ്റിൽമെൻ്റ് റേഷ്യോ ഡാറ്റ

**ശ്രദ്ധിക്കുക:** നിരസിക്കൽ നിരക്കുകൾ കണക്കാക്കുന്നത് (ക്ലെയിമുകൾ നിരസിക്കപ്പെട്ടത് / ലഭിച്ച ക്ലെയിമുകൾ) × 100. ഇതിൽ ഭാഗികമായ നിരാകരണങ്ങൾ ഉൾപ്പെടുന്നു, തുടക്കത്തിൽ നിരസിച്ചതും പിന്നീട് അപ്പീലിൽ അംഗീകരിച്ചതുമായ ക്ലെയിമുകൾ കണക്കിലെടുക്കുന്നില്ല.
